Gealah hammakdish kodem sheyyaggia hayyovel hare zo chozeret livaleha vehaerech shennatan yippol levedek habbayit kemo shebbearnu. vechen im gealah beno shel makdish hare zo chozeret leaviv bayyovel. aval im gaala otah bitto o shear kerovav o nachri miyyad hahekdesh. im chazar hammakdish ugealah miyyadan chozeret lo leolam. veim lo gealah miyyadan ella higgia hayyovel vehi tachat yad habbat o shear kerovim o nachri hare zo yotza lahekdesh veenah chozeret labbealim leolam. ella tihye achuzza lakkohanim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 21)</small> "vehaya hassade betzeto vayyovel lakkohen" vegomer. veen hakkohanim tzerichin litten damim shekkevar nifdet miyyad hahekdesh velakach erkah meuchar ella tachzor lakkohanim keillu hem bealeha: 
Bamme devarim amurim beyisrael. aval im haya hammakdish kohen o levi hare ze goel leolam. vaafillu avar aleha hayyovel velo nifdet min hahekdesh pode otah achar hayyovel shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 32)</small> "geullat olam tihye lalviyyim": 
Haishsha shehikdisha sede achuzzatah ugealah balah miyyad hahekdesh vehiggia hayyovel vehi tachat yad habbaal hare haddavar safek im tachzor laishsha o tetze lakkohanim. lefichach kadma haishsha vehechezika bah achar hayyovel en hakkohanim yecholin lehotzi miyyadah. vechen im kadmu hakkohanim vehecheziku bah enah yechola lehotzi miyyadam: 
Hammakdish sadehu ufada otah kohen miyyad hahekdesh vehiggia hayyovel vehi tachat yad hakkohen lo yomar hoil vahare hi yotza lakkohanim hare hi tachat yadi vezachiti bah ella yotza lechol echav hakkohanim: 
Keshettetze hassade lakkohanim bayyovel tinnaten lakkohanim shebbammishmar sheppaga bo hayyovel. veim haya rosh hashshana shel yovel beshabbat shehare mishmar yotze umishmar nichnas tinnaten lammishmar hayyotze: 
Hammakdish et hailanot vehiggia hayyovel velo padu otam enan yotzin lakkohanim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 21)</small> "vehaya hassade betzeto vayyovel" veen ellu sade. aval hammakdish et hatterashim vehiggia yovel velo padu otan habbealim hare ellu yotzin lakkohanim shenneemar vehaya hassade vezo nikret sade: 
Ketzad din makdish sede miknato. shamin otah bedameha veroin kamma hi shava ad hayyovel ufode otah kol mi sheyyirtze. veim pada otah hammakdish eno mosif chomesh ufidyonah levedek habbayit kishar arachin vedamim. uchesheyyaggia hayyovel tachzor labbealim harishonim shemmecharuha. ben shennifdet miyyad haggizbar vahare hi yotza miyyad acher. ben shello nifdet vahare hi yotza miyyad hahekdesh hare zo chozeret lammocher veenah yotza lakkohanim sheen adam makdish davar sheeno shello: 
Kol sade sheshshamin otah lahekdesh limkor otah bedameha machrizin aleha shishshim yom retzufin babboker bishat hachenasat poalim uvaerev bishat hotzaat poalim. umesayyemin metzareha veomer kach hi yafa uvechach hi shuma kol harotze likkach yavo veyikkach: 
Hallokeach sade meaviv o mishshear hammorishin oto vehikdishah. ben shehikdishah achar mot aviv o morisho. uven shehikdishah bechayye aviv o shear morishav veachar kach met aviv hare zo kisde achuzza. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 22)</small> "veim et sede miknato asher lo missede achuzzato" sade sheenah reuya lihyot sede achuzza yatzat zo sheruya lo leyorshah:

Hammakdish sede achuzzato mitzva alav lifdotah hu shehaadon kodem. veim lo ratza en kofin oto. bamme devarim amurim bizman shemmitzvat yovel noheget sheim yaggia yovel velo yigalenna tetze lakkohanim kemo shebbearnu. aval bizman shebbatlu hayyovlot shehare enah yotzet lakkohanim ella sofah lehippadot leolam kofin et haadon liftoach bah techilla vehi nifdet beshavyah kishar hahekdeshot. im nimtza mi shemmosif alav vegoel otah yigal veim lav omrin lo higgiatcha veyitten ma sheamar veeno poteach befachot mearba perutot kede sheyyehe hachomesh shemmosif peruta: 
Ratza haadon limkor sadot acherot missedotav o lilvot kede lifdot sade zo shehikdish harshut beyado. ben bizman shehayyovel noheg ben bizman sheen hayyovel noheg. vehu kodem lechol adam. vechen im ratza ligl chetzyah goel. ma sheen ken bemocher lehedyot. ze chomer behedyot mibbehekdesh: 
Hammakdish et beto o et behema temea shello o shear mittaltelav hare ellu neerachin beshavyehen ben tov uven ra. veim pada otan hammakdish o ishto o yorsho mosif chomesh. vechofin et habbealim liftoach rishon vehaddamim levedek habbayit. ben shehaya habbayit mibbatte are choma ben shehaya mibbatte hachatzerim hare ze nigal leolam: 
Gealo acher miyyad hahekdesh im haya bet are choma vekam beyad haggoel shenem asar chodesh nechlat. veim haya bet hachatzerim vehiggia hayyovel vehu beyad haggoel chozer livalav bayyovel: 
Hammakdish behema tehora temima levedek habbayit af al pi sheavar al ase ma sheasa asuy vechala kedushsha aleha venifdet keshehi temima. umaarich otah hakkohen bedameha. vehaddamim yippelu levedek habbayit. veen happode otah pode ella al menat lehakerivah lammizbeach lema shehi reuya. shekkol davar harauy lammizbeach eno yotze mide mizbeach leolam: 
Uminnayin sheasur lehakedish temimin levedek habbayit shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 23)</small> "veshor vase sarua vekalut nedava taase oto". mippi hashshemua lamdu nedava levedek habbayit. vechen haddevarim marin sheenah ella kedushshat damim. sheen makrivin baal mum lammizbeach shenneemar oto <small>(Vayikra 22 23)</small> "oto" atta ose nedava levedek habbayit veen atta ose temimim nedava levedek habbayit. velav habba mikkelal ase kaase hu: 
Hammakdish et behemto setam o shehikdish et nechasav setam roin kol behema temima haruya lehakeriv al gabbe hammizbeach zecharim yimmachru letzarche olot veyakrivu otan olot. vehannekevot yimmachru letzarche shelamim veyakrivu otan shelamim. vehaddamim yippelu levedek habbayit shessetam hekdeshot levedek habbayit. veal ze neemar <small>(Vayikra 27 9)</small> "veim behema asher yakrivu mimmenna karban laAdonai kol asher yitten mimmennu laAdonai yihye kodesh" kelomar kol harauy lekarban al gabbe hammizbeach yikkarev: 
Hikdish nechasav setam vehayu bahen yenot ushemanim uselatot veofot haruyin likkarev al gabbe hammizbeach yimmachru letzarche oto hammin veyakrivu otan vehaddamim yillakach bahen zecharim veyakrivu olot: 
Umippene ma yakrivu deme ellu olot udeme habbehema hattemima yippelu levedek habbayit. lefi shehabbehema hakkedosha lammizbeach im nafal bah mum yesh lah pidyon kemo sheyyitbaer vehassolet vehayyayin vehashshemen vehaofot shennifselu en lahen pidyon shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 11)</small> "veheemid et habbehema" vegomer kol sheyyeshno bichlal haamada vehaaracha yesh lah pidyon vechol sheeno bichlal haamada vehaaracha en lah pidyon: 
Hikdish nechasav setam vehayta bahen hakketoret shennotnin leammanin bischaran ad sheyyachzeru veyikchu otah kemo shebbearnu bishkalim. hare zo tinnaten leammanin bischaran kemo sheosin bemotar hakketoret. vechen osin im yesh binchasav echad missammane hakketoret: 
Hammakdish behema temima lammizbeach venafal bah mum venifsela hare zo neerechet venifdet. veal ze neemar <small>(Vayikra 27 11)</small> "veim kol behema temea asher lo yakrivu mimmenna karban laAdonai veheemid et habbehema" vegomer. veyavi bedameha karban acher kemotah: 
Kol hammakdish behema bechayyeha ben tehora ben temea ben kadshe habbayit ben kadshe mizbeach shennafal bahen mum o temima haruya likkarev kemo sheyyitbaer hare zo tzericha haamada bevet din shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 11)</small> "veheemid et habbehema". lefichach im meta habbehema kodem shettearech vetippade en podin otah achar shemmeta ella tikkaver. aval im hikdish shechuta o nevela levedek habbayit hare zo tippade kishar mittaltelin: 
Shachat bah shenayim o rov shenayim vaadayin hi mefarkeset hare hi kechayya lechol devareha veneerechet vahare hi bichlal veheemid veheerich ad shettamut: 
Hammakdish behema temima ledameha hare zo nitkaddesh gufah. ketzad. haomer deme behema zo hekdesh lammizbeach hi atzmah tikkarev. hikdish echad meevareha ledamav veamar deme raglah shel para zo hekdesh lammizbeach hare zo safek im pashta kedushsha bechullah o lo pashta. ulefichach tikkarev velo tippade: 
Vketzad osin. mochrin otah kullah lemi sheyyakriv otah. vedameha chullin chutz middeme oto evar. veim haya evar shehanneshama teluya bo pashta kedushsha bechullah: 
Hayta behema baalat mum sheenah reuya likkarev vehikdish evar meevareha ledamav ben shehanneshama teluya bo ben shehanneshama en teluya bo lo nitkaddesh ella deme oto evar bilvad. ketzad. kegon sheamar deme regel para zo o deme libbah hekdesh lammizbeach. hu vehekdesh shuttafin bah: 
Vechen haomer rosh eved ze o lev chamor ze hekdesh lammizbeach o sheamar roshi hekdesh lammizbeach eno chayyav ella bidme rosho veroin kamma yishve oto evar illu haya nimkar veyavi bedamav karban: 
Bamme devarim amurim bekadshe mizbeach. aval bekadshe bedek habbayit haomer deme rosh chamor ze o kevedo hekdesh o deme rosh eved ze o kevedo hekdesh hoil vehu davar shehanneshama teluya bo hare ze chayyav bidme kullo. shekkol hekdesh bedek habbayit kedushshat damim hu: 
Haomer erki alay lammizbeach mevi beerko karban. veim en yado masseget leerech shalem hare ze devar safek im niddon behesseg yad hoil vehotzio bilshon erech. o eno niddon behesseg yad hoil velammizbeach nadar. vechen hammakdish sede achuzzato lammizbeach hare zo nifdet vehaddamim yaviu bahen olot lammizbeach. veyesh baddavar safek im podin otah baerech hakkatzuv bah o podin otah beshavyan hoil velammizbeach hikdish vedanin bechol ellu vechayyotze bahen lehachemir:

Echad haomer hare ze hekdesh levedek habbayit o cherem levedek habbayit o cherem lashshamayim. vechen bechol nechasav im amar kol nechasav hekdesh o cherem levedek habbayit o cherem lashshamayim hare ellu yippelu levedek habbayit. aval im amar cherem setam hare ellu lakkohanim. shessetam charamim lakkohanim. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 14)</small> "kol cherem beyisrael lecha yihye":

Machrim adam min bekaro umitztzono umeavadav umishshifchotav hakkenaanim umissede achuzzato. aval lo yacharim kol behemto velo kol avadav velo kol sedotav velo kol min sheyyesh lo mishshear hammittaltelin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 28)</small> "mikkol asher lo". veim hecherim et hakkol afillu hecherim kol nechasav hare ellu muchramin ben shehechrim lakkohanim ben shehecherim levedek habbayit:
Vechol mi shehecherim o hikdish kol nechasav lokchin kol ma sheyyesh lo vaafilu tefillin shebberosho. veen tzarich lomar kele ummenuto uvegadav shehakkol hekdesh o cherem:

Ma ben cherme kohanim lecherme shamayim. shecherme shamayim hekdesh venifdin beshavyehen veyippelu haddamim levedek habbayit veyetzu hannechasim lechullin. vecherme kohanim en lahen pidyon leolam ella nittanin lakkohanim kitruma. veal cherem kohanim hu omer <small>(Vayikra 27 28)</small> "lo yimmacher velo yiggael". lo yimmacher leacher velo yiggael labbealim:

Veechad hammacharim karka o mittaltelin hare ellu nittanin lakkohen shebbeoto mishmar. beshaa shehecherim cherme kohanim kol zeman shehen bevet habbealim hare hen hekdesh lechol divrehem. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 28)</small> "kol cherem kodesh kadashim hu laAdonai". netano lakkohen hare hen kechullin lechol divrehem. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 14)</small> "kol cherem beyisrael lecha yihye":

Kohen shehayta lo sede cherem shezzacha bah achar hayyovel vehecherimah hare zo muchremet veyotza leechav hakkohanim. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 21)</small> "lakkohen tihye achuzzato" melammed shessede chermo lo kisde achuzza leyisrael sheim hecherimah hi muchremet miyyad:

Machar hakkohen sede chermo vehikdishah lokeach afillu haya hallokeach habbealim harishonim shehecherimuha hare zo kisde mikna vechozeret lakkohen shemmecharah bayyovel. aval karka o mittaltelin shel kohanim uleviyyim enam machrimin otan shehare omer besade <small>(Vayikra 25 34)</small> "ki achuzzat olam hu lachem". umittaltelin hukkeshu lekarkaot bacharamin shenneemar <small>(gemara arachin koach 1)</small> "mikkol asher lo umissede achuzzato":

Hammakdish kadshe mizbeach levedek habbayit hare hahekdesh chal alehen vetearech habbehema vetippade veyippelu dameha levedek habbayit vehabbehema tikkarev lema shehayta battechilla. aval hammakdish kadshe bedek habbayit lammizbeach veamar hare ze ola o shelamim o hecherimam lakkohanim lo asa kelum veen hekdesh mizbeach velo hacherem chal al kadshe bedek habbayit sheen adam makdish davar sheeno shello:

Haomer shor ze hekdesh leachar sheloshim yom ushechato betoch sheloshim yom hare ze muttar bahanaa. hikdisho lammizbeach hare ze hekdesh lammizbeach. aval im amar hare ze hekdesh meachshav leachar sheloshim yom ushechato betoch sheloshim yom hare ze asur bahanaa. veim hikdisho betoch hashsheloshim lammizbeach eno mukdash:
Hammakdish ola levedek habbayit en bah ella ikkuv gizbarin bilvad. umiddivre sofrim shello tishshachet ad shettippade. lefichach im avar ushechatah hare zo keshera:

Macharim adam ben kadshe kadashim ben kadashim kallim ben cherme kohanim ben cherme bedek habbayit. veim hayu kadashim shehu chayyav beacharayutan noten et demehen ben lakkohanim ben levedek habbayit veyikkarvu otan hakkadashim achar sheyyippadu lema shehen:
Hayu nedava vehecheriman ketzad podin otan. omdim kamma adam rotze litten bivhema zo lehaalotah ola sheeno chayyav bah. vechol hannoten oto shiur yakriv behema zo nedava kemo shehayta:
Yisrael shehechrim et bechor behema lashshamayim ben shehaya tamim ben shehaya baal mum hare ze muchram. veen tzarich lomar shehechrimo hakkohen lashshamayim achar shebba leyado:

Vechetzad podin otan. omdin kamma adam rotze litten bivchor ze kede sheyyihye lo vetihye harshut beyado litteno lechol kohen sheyyirtze likrovo o lereo. vechol hannoten oto shiur yikkach habbechor veyittenennu lechol kohen sheyyirtze veyippelu haddamim levedek habbayit:
Hammacharim et hammaaser hare ze kemacharim shalme nedava lefi sheeno chayyav beacharayuto:
Hammakdish shiklo levedek habbayit hare ze kodesh. hikdish bikkurim levedek habbayit enan kodesh. aval im hikdishan hakkohen achar shebbau leyado hare ellu kodesh:

Hammacharim chatzi avdo veshifchato hu vehakkohanim shuttafin bo. aval im hikdish o hecherim lashshamayim chatzi avdo kullo kodesh kemo shebbearnu. vechol hammakdish avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim o hammakdish kol nechasav vehayu bahen avadim hare gufan kodesh lefichach asurim lehanot bahen ad sheyyippadu:
Veen haggizbarin rashshain likkach demehen meacherim ulehotzi otan lecherut ella mochrin otan laacherim vaacherim motziin otan lecherut im ratzu:

Hammakdish yede avdo kol hayyeter al parnasato kodesh. vechetzad hu mitparnes eved ze. love veochel veose uforea. vehu sheyyaase pachot pachot mishsheve peruta veyifra. sheim asa bifruta rishon rishon kana hekdesh:
Hammakdish et atzmo lo hikdish ella damav vahare hu chayyav bidme atzmo. umuttar lo laasot veleechol shehare lo nitkaddesh gufo keeved:
En adam makdish davar sheeno shello. ketzad. kegon shehechrim beno uvitto veavdo veshifchato haivrim o sede miknato hare ellu enan muchramin. sheen adam makdish davar sheen gufo shello:

En adam makdish davar sheeno birshuto. ketzad. haya lo pikkadon beyad acher vechafar bo ze shehu etzlo en habbealim yecholin lehakedisho. aval im lo kafar bo hare hu birshut bealav bechol makom shehu:

Bamme devarim amurim bemittaltelin. aval karka sheggezalah acher vechafar bah im yachol lehotziah bedayyanin hare ze yachol lehakedishah veaf al pi sheadayin lo hotziah shehakkarka atzmah hare hi birshut bealeha:
Haggozel et chavero velo nityaashu habbealim shenehem enan yecholin lehakedish. ze lefi sheeno shello veze lefi sheeno birshuto. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Mi shehaya mocher deluin o betzim vechayyotze bahen uva lokeach venatal achat vehalach lo. im hayu deme kol achat veachat ketzuvin hare ze kemi sheppasak. veen hammocher yachol lehakedish delaat zo shehare enah birshuto. veim en haddamim ketzuvin vehikdishah mekuddeshet sheadayin birshuto hi shezze shellekachah lo lekachah derech gezela. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
En adam makdish davar shello ba laolam. ketzad. ma shettaale metzudati min hayyam kodesh. ma shettotzi sade zo min happerot cherem. lo amar kelum:
Haomer lachavero sade zo shemmacharti lecha lichsheekkachenna mimmecha mekuddeshet ulekachah enah mekuddeshet. lefi shekkeshehikdishah lo baa birshuto:

Vechen hammakdish maase yede ishto hare zo osa veochelet vehammotar chullin. amar lah yikdeshu yadayich leosehen hoil vehen meshubadin lo hare kol maase yadeha kodesh. ha lema ze dome leomer ilan ze kodesh shekkol perot sheyyaase lehabba kodesh. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Haomer lachavero sade zo sheani mocher lecha lichsheekkachenna mimmecha titkaddesh hare zo mekuddeshet kesheyyikkachenna shehare atta (ba) beyado lehakedishah. sade zo shemmishkanti lecha lichsheefdenna mimmecha tehi kodesh. mishsheyyifde otah titkaddesh shehare beyado lifdotah. vaafillu hayta memushkenet lizman katzuv shehare beyado lifdotah achar hazzeman:
Hammaskir bayit lachavero vechazar vehikdisho hare ze kodesh ufaka hassechirut. veim dar bo hassocher maal:

Yerae li sheaf al pi sheen adam makdish davar shello ba laolam im amar hare alay lehakedisho hare ze chayyav lehakedisho kesheyyavo laolam mishshum nidro. veim lo hikdish hare ze over mishshum <small>(Devarim 23 22)</small> "bal teacher" v<small>(Bamidbar 30 3)</small> "lo yachel devaro" umishshum <small>(Bamidbar 30 3)</small> "kechol hayyotze mippiv yaase" kishar hannedarim:

Ketzad. haomer hare alay lehakedish kol shettaale metzudati min hayyam. hare alay litten laaniyyim perot shettotzi sade zo. hare alay lehacharim o litten lishvuyim kol sheestakker beshana zo. vechol kayyotze bemaamarim ellu hare ze chayyav litten velaasot bahen ma sheamar kesheyyavou leyado. veze vechayyotze bo bichlal nedarim hu lo bichlal hekdeshot:

Reaya ledavar ze ma sheamar yaakov avinu <small>(Bereshit 28 22)</small> "vechl asher titten li asser aasserennu lach" veneemar <small>(Bereshit lo 13)</small> "asher nadarta li sham neder". vahare haomer lo eppater min haolam ad sheeheye nazir chayyav linhog binzirut veaf al pi sheadayin lo nadar benazir. hoil veamar sheyyiddor benazir chayyav lehinnazer. veze kayyotze bo vechaze rauy ladun:

Hekdesh taut eno hekdesh. ketzad. haomer shor shachor sheyyetze mibbayit rishon hare hu hekdesh veyatza lavan eno hekdesh. dinar zahav sheyyaale beyadi rishon hare hu hekdesh veala shel kesef eno hekdesh. chavit shel yayin shettaale beyadi rishona hekdesh veala shel shemen ben shehayyayin yakar min hashshemen beoto makom o hashshemen yakar min hayyayin eno hekdesh. hitpis bah acheret veamar zo kazo hare hashsheniyya hekdesh. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hahekdeshot en podin otan lo bekarka. velo baavadim shehare hukkeshu lekarkaot. velo bishtarot (mippene) sheen gufan mamon shenneemar venatan et hakkesef. echad hakkesef veechad shear hammittaltelin sheshshavin kesef. vaafilu subbin: 
Kol happode kadashav mosif chomesh. veechad hammakdish atzmo o ishto o hayyoresh mosifim chomesh kemo shebbearnu. veaf hachomesh lo yihye ella min hammittaltelin. vehachomesh shemmosif hare hu kehekdesh atzmo vedin echad lahem: 
Happode kadashav en hachomesh meakkev. ella meachar shennatan et hakkeren yatza hakkodesh lechullin umuttar lehanot bo. umiddivre sofrim sheasur lo lehanot ad sheyyitten hachomesh shemma yifsha velo yitten. aval beshabbat mippene oneg shabbat hittiru lo leechol veaf al pi sheadayin lo natan et hachomesh vahare haggizbarin tovin oto: 
Kadshe mizbeach shennafal bahem mum venifdu. im pada hammakdish atzmo mosif chomesh kishar hahekdeshot. vehammakdish sheppada leatzmo hu shemmosif chomesh lo hammitkapper bah sheppedaah. vehekdesh rishon hu shechayyav betosefet chomesh. aval hekdesh sheni eno mosif alav chomesh. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 15)</small> "veim hammakdish yigal et beto veyasaf chamishit". hammakdish velo hammatpis: 
Lefichach im chillel behema al behema sheniyya ben bekadshe bedek habbayit ben bekadshe mizbeach shennafal bahem mum. o shehemir bekadshe mizbeach. keshehu pode et hashsheniyya shechillel aleha o et hattemura leatzmo eno mosif chomesh: 
Hammafrish asham lehitkapper bo venafal bo mum vehosif alav chomesh vechillelo al behema acheret venitkapper beasham acher venitteka habbehema shechillel aleha liriyya kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo. hare hu safek im mosif aleha chomesh hoil vehu karban ola vahare hu guf echad ukedushsha acheret. o eno mosif aleha chomesh mippene shehi baa mikkoach hekdesh rishon shekkevar hosif alav chomesh: 
Kadshe bedek habbayit en osin temura shello dana tora bitmura ella bekadshe mizbeach. ketzad. hayu lefanav behemat chullin uvehemat kadshe bedek habbayit veamar zo chalufat zo o zo temurat zo lo amar kelum. aval im amar hare zo tachat zo hare zo mechullelet al zo devarav kayyamin veyatzta habbehema harishona lechullin venitpesa hashsheniyya: 
Echad kadshe bedek habbayit veechad kadshe mizbeach shennafal bahen mum en podin otan lechattechilla ella beshavyehen. veim avar vechillelan al pachot mishshavyehen afillu hekdesh shave mea dinar shechillelo al sheve peruta hare ze paduy veyatza lechullin umuttar lehanot bo. umiddivre sofrim shehu tzarich chakirat damim vechayyav lehashelim et damav: 
Ketzad. hayta lo behemat kadshe mizbeach shennafal bah mum vahare hi shava asara uvehemat chullin sheshshava chamishsha veamar hare zo mechullelet al zo hare zo nifdet veyatzat lechullin aval tzarich lehashelim hachamishsha. vechen im hayta habbehema harishona kadshe bedek habbayit hare zo yatzat lechullin lehiggazez uleheaved vetikkanes hashsheniyya tachteha din tora. aval middivrehem tzarich chakirat damim im hayta zo shechillel aleha shava o yashlim dameha: 
Shamu otah shelosha veamru shezzo bedameha afillu bau achar ken mea veamru shel kodesh hayta yafa eno chozer. hoil vachakirat haddamim middivrehem lo hechmiru bah. aval im shamu otah shenayim uvau shelosha veamru shehona hahekdesh bechol shehu chozer: 
En podin et hahekdesh achsara ella bachakirat damim kemo shebbearnu. veim pada yad hekdesh al haelyona. ketzad. para zo tachat para zo shel hekdesh tallit zo tachat tallit zo shel hekdesh. hekdesho paduy veyad hekdesh al haelyona. im hayta hashsheniyya yafa min harishona beyoter lokchin otah haggizbarin veshotkin. veim enah yafa meshallem et haddamim kemo shebbearnu umosif chomesh. aval im amar tallit zo beeser selaim tachat tallit shel hekdesh ufara zo beeser selaim tachat para zo shel hekdesh. afillu hayta shel hekdesh shava chamesh veshello eser hare ze mosif chomesh venoten shete selaim umechetza shehare bedamim ketzuvim pada. usheniyya enah teuna chomesh kemo shebbearnu: 
Happode miyyad hahekdesh mashach bemane velo hispik litten haddamim ad sheamad bematayim noten matayim shenneemar venatan et hakkesef vekam lo. bintinat hakkesef hu shello. meshacho bematayim velo hispik litten et haddamim ad sheamad bemane noten matayim. lo yehe koach hedyot chamur mikkoach hekdesh. vahare kana bimshicha venitchayyev baddamim: 
Pada bematayim venatan haddamim velo hispik lemashcho ad sheamad bemane kevar kana bintinat hakkesef umoshech et shello vezacha hekdesh bematayim. padahu bemane venatan haddamim velo hispik lemashcho ad sheamad bematayim ma sheppada paduy veeno noten ella hammane shekkevar natan. veen omrin kan lo yehe koach hedyot chamur mikkoach hekdesh. sheafillu hedyot eno yachol lachzor bo ad sheyyekabbel mi sheppara kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo veen hekdesh rauy lekabbel mi sheppara: 
Hammakdish kol nechasav vehayta alav ketubbat ishsha o shitre baale chovot. en haishsha yechola ligbot ketubbatah min hahekdesh velo baal chov et chovo. shehahekdesh mafkia hashshibud shekkadam. aval kesheyyimkor hahekdesh hakkarka shello vetetze hassade lechullin yesh levaal chov uleishsha ligbot min happode shehare shibudah omed al karka zo: 
Ha lema ze dome lishne lakochot shekkatva larishon din udevarim en li immecha umachar lashsheni shehi torefet min hashsheni: 
Vechetzad podin karka ze. mashbiin et haishsha o baal chov techilla kederech kol habba lippara minnechasim meshubadim veachar kach machrizin alehem shishshim yom babboker uvaerev kemo shebbearnu. veomdin kamma adam rotze litten bassade al menat litten leishsha ketubbatah ulevaal chov et chovo. veachar sheppodin otah velokeach otah hallokeach afillu bedinar kede shello yomru hekdesh yotze belo pidyon. chozer happode umagbe laishsha ketubbatah o labbaal chov et chovo. afillu haya hachov mea vehassade shava tishim al menat kach pode otah harotze lifdotah. aval im haya hachov shenayim bidme hassade kegon shehayta shava mea veyesh alav chov uchetubbat ishsha matayim en podin otah al menat litten hachov o hakketubba ella podin otah setam sheim hitnu litten enah nifdet kelal: 
Hammakdish kol nechasav veachar kach geresh et ishto vegavta ketubbatah min happode min hahekdesh eno gove ad sheyyaddirenna hanaa. shemma kenuneya asu al hahekdesh. veen omrin illu ratza haya omer betaut hikdashti veyishshael al hekdesho lechacham veyachzor lo: 
Vechen en neeman lomar achar shehikdish mane lifloni chov alay o keli ze shel peloni hu. shemma yaasu kenuneya al hahekdesh. vaafillu haya shetar beyad baal chov eno gove al pi ze ella kederech sheggovin kol baale chovot kemo shebbearnu: 
Bamme devarim amurim bevari. aval chole shehikdish kol nechasav veamar beshaa shehikdish mane lifloni beyadi neeman. sheen adam ose arma al hahekdesh bishat mitato vechote laacherim shehare hu holech lamut. lefichach im amar tenu otah lo notel belo shevua. veim lo amar tenu en notnin ella im ken haya beyado shetar mekuyyam. hare ze notel min hahekdesh mippene hatztzavvaa. veim achar shehikdish amar tenu en shomin lo ella hare hu kishar baale chovot. im nitkayyem shetaro nishba vegove min happode velo min hahekdesh: 
Mi sheyyatza alav kol shehifkir et nechasav o hikdishan o hecheriman en choshshin lo ad shettihye sham reaya berura:

Bachamisha asar baadar bet din nifnin lechappes velivdok al tzarche tzibbur veal inyene hahekdeshot. uvodkin alehen vedorshin vechokrin ufodim et hahekdeshot veet hacharamin vegovin et haarachin veet haddamim mikkol hachayyav bahen kede sheyyihye kol haam atid litten terumat hashshekalim lechazzek et bet elohenu: 
En podin et hahekdeshot ella bishlosha bekiin. vechen kesheggovin mittaltelin shemmemashkenin mechayyave arachin shamin otan bishlosha. ucheshemmaarichin behema vechayyotze bah mishshear mittaltelin shamin otah bishlosha. aval keshemmaarichin et hakkarkaot o im huzkeku ligbot erche adam min hakkarka shello en maarichin otan ella baasara veechad mehen kohen shehare <small>(Vayikra 27 8)</small> "kohen" katuv bapparasha. vechen haomer damay alay o deme peloni alay o deme yadi o ragli alay kesheshshamin oto kamma hu shave o kamma deme yado o raglo shamin baasara veechad mehen kohen: 
Kesheppodin hahekdeshot miyyad hahekdesh ben shehayu karkaot o mittaltelin machrizin alehen bifne kol habbain lifdot. amar echad hare hen shelli beeser selaim veamar echad beesrim veamar echad bishloshim veamar echad bearbaim veamar echad bachamishshim. chazar bo shel chamishshim levaddo memashkenin minnechasav eser venotnin otan hahekdeshot laze shennatan arbaim venimtza hahekdesh notel chamishshim eser mizze vearbaim mizze. chazar bo achare ken shel arbaim memashkenin minnechasav eser venotnin et hahekdesh levaal hashsheloshim vechen ad harishon. chazar bo harishon shennatan eser machrizin al hahekdesh paam sheniyya umochrin oto. im nifda befachot meeser nifrain mishshel baal haeser et hammotar: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshechazru ze achar ze. aval chazru kullan keechad meshalleshin benehem beshave. ketzad. amar harishon hare hu shelli beeser veamar hashsheni beesrim veamar hashshelishi bearbaa veesrim vechazar bo hashshelishi vehashsheni keechad notnin oto larishon beeser. umemashkenim minnichse hashsheni besheva uminnichse shelishi besheva venimtza hahekdesh gove arba veesrim. vechen im chazru shelashtan keachat venimkar hahekdesh beshalosh memashkenin minnichse kol echad mishshelashtan sheva selaim. vechen al derech zo leolam: 
Habbealim kodmin lechol adam mippene shehen mosifin chomesh. veen mosifin chomesh al illuyan shel shear happodim ella al ma shennatnu hem techilla. ketzad. amru habbealim hare ze shellanu beesrim uva acher veamar hare hu shelli beesrim habbealim kodmin mippene shehen mosifin chomesh venotnin chamesh veesrim. ba echad veamar hare hu shelli beachat veesrim im shatku habbealim velo hosifu kelum mochrin otah lahem bechamesh veesrim. veim hosifu habbealim al esrim veachat afillu peruta achat hare ellu notnin shesh veesrim uferuta achat. achat veesrim uferuta shennatnu meatzman vechamesh shehen chayyavin bo mishshum chomesh hammattan shennatnu techilla. vechen im ba hashsheni veamar hare hu shelli beesrim ushetayim. uva shelishi veamar beesrim veshalosh. uva revii veamar beesrim vearba. uva hachamishi veamar beesrim vechamesh. vehosifu hen al haesrim vechamesh afillu peruta achat kofin otan litten sheloshim uferuta. chamesh veesrim uferuta shennatnu meatzman. vechamesh mechomesh shehen chayyavin bo. lefi sheen habbealim mosifin chomesh al illuyo shel ze ella chomesh ma shennatnu techilla mosifin al ma shennatan haacharon im ratzu: 
Bamme devarim amurim shello shamu hahekdesh shelosha mumchin. aval im shamu oto shelosha mumchin veamru shehu shave ma shennatan haacharon vehosifu habbealim al illuyo afillu peruta achat hare hen mosifin chomesh al illuyo shel acharon venotnin achat usheloshim vedinar uferuta: 
Hare shello nishshom hahekdesh. venatnu habbealim techilla esrim uva acher venatan chamesh veesrim veshatku habbealim velo hosifu kelum. habbealim kodmin sheaf hen chayyavin litten chamesh veesrim mippene hachomesh. ba acher venatan shesh veesrim hu kodem. veim ratzu habbealim vehosifu afillu peruta notnin achat usheloshim uferuta kemo shebbearnu. veal derech zo leolam: 
En makdishin velo maarichin velo machrimin bazzeman hazze sheen sham mikdash bachataenu kede lechazzek et bidko. veim hikdish o heerich o hecherim im hayta behema noel delet befaneha ad shettamut meeleha. veim hayu perot o kesut o kelim mannichin otan ad sheyyerakvu. veim hayu maot o kele mattachot yashlichen leyam hammelach o layyam haggadol kede leabbedan: 
Hikdish o hecherim eved shennichnas lemitzvot podehu veyelchu damav leyam hammelach kishar damim vaarachin shel zeman hazze. veim haya eved akkum lo maalin velo moridin: 
Muttar lifdot hahekdeshot bazzeman hazze lechattechilla vaafilu bifruta umashlich otah leyam hammelach. vachachamim danu sheyyifde bearbaa zuzim o karov laze kede lefarsem haddavar. aval bizman hammikdash lo yifde lechattechilla ella beshavyo kemo shebbearnu: 
Mi shehechrim bazzeman hazze mittaltelin setam hare ellu notnan lakkohanim hannimtzain beoto makom. aval im hecherim sade beeretz yisrael setam o shehecherimah lakkohanim enah cherem. sheen sede charamim noheg ella bizman shehayyovel noheg. hecherim lakkohanim karka bechutz laaretz vaafillu bazzeman hazze hare hi kemittaltelin baaretz yisrael vetinnaten lakkohanim: 
Af al pi shehahekdeshot vehacharamin vehaarachin mitzvot verauy lo leadam lehanehig atzmo bidvarim ellu kede lachof yitzro velo yihye kilay vikayyem ma shetztziuu neviim <small>(Mishlei 3 9)</small> "kabbed et Adonai mehonecha". af al pi chen im lo hikdish velo heerich velo hecherim meolam en bechach kelum. hare hattora heida veamra <small>(Devarim 23 23)</small> "vechi techdal lindor lo yihye vecha chet": 
Leolam lo yakdish adam velo yacharim kol nechasav. vehaose ken over al daat hakkatuv shehare hu omer <small>(Vayikra 27 28)</small> "mikkol asher lo" velo kol asher lo kemo shebbearu chachamim. veen zo chasidut ella shetut shehare hu meabbed kol mamono veyitztarech labberiyyot. veen merachamin alav. uvaze vechayyotze bo amru chachamim chasid shote mikkelal mevalle olam. ella kol hamefazzer mamono bemitzvot al yefazzer yoter mechomesh. veyihye kemo shetztziuu neviim <small>(Tehillim 112 5)</small> "mechalkel devarav bemishpat" ben bedivre tora ben bedivre olam. afillu bekarbanot sheadam chayyav bahen hare chasa tora al hammamon veamra sheyyavi kefi missat yado. kal vachomer lidvarim shello nitchayyev bahen ella mechamat nidro shello yindor ella karauy lo shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 17)</small> "ish kemattenat yado kevirkat Adonai elohecha asher natan lach":
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 1: Mitzvat ase min hattora levarech achar achilat mazon shenneemar <small>(Devarim 8 10)</small> "veachalta vesavata uverachta et Adonai elohecha". veeno chayyav min hattora ella im ken sava shenneemar veachalta vesavata uverachta. umiddivre sofrim achal afillu kezayit mevarech acharav:

Umiddivre sofrim levarech al kol maachol techilla veachar kach yehane mimmennu. vaafillu nitkavven leechol o lishtot kol shehu mevarech veachar kach yehane. vechen im heriach reach tov mevarech veachar kach yehane mimmennu. vechol hannehene belo beracha maal. vechen middivre sofrim levarech achar kol ma sheyyochal vechol ma sheyyishte. vehu sheyyishte reviit vehu sheyyochal kezayit. umatemet enah tzericha beracha lo lefaneha velo leachareha ad reviit:

Ucheshem shemmevarchin al hahanaya kach mevarchin al kol mitzva umitzva veachar kach yaase otah. uverachot rabbot tikkenu chachamim derech shevach vehodaya vederech bakkasha kede lizkor et habbore tamid af al pi shello nehena velo asa mitzva:
Nimtzeu kol habberachot kullan shelosha minim. birchot hanaya. uvirchot mitzvot. uvirchot hodaa shehen derech shevach vehodaya uvakkasha kede lizkor et habbore tamid uleyira mimmennu:

Venosach kol habberachot ezra uvet dino tikkenum. veen rauy leshannotam velo lehosif al achat mehem velo ligroa mimmenna. vechol hameshanne mimmatbea shettavu chachamim babberachot eno ella toe. vechol beracha sheen bah hazekarat hashshem umalchut enah beracha ella im ken hayta semucha lachavertah:
Vechol habberachot kullan neemarin bechol lashon vehu sheyyomar keen shettikkenu chachamim. veim shinna et hammatbea hoil vehizkir azkara umalchut veinyan habberacha afillu bilshon chol yatza:
Kol habberachot kullan tzarich sheyyashmia leazno ma shehu omer veim lo hishmia leazno yatza ben shehotzi bisfatav ben shebberech belibbo:

Kol habberachot kullan lo yafsik ben habberacha uven haddavar shemmevarchin alav bidvarim acherim veim hifsik tzarich lachazor ulevarech sheniyya. veim hifsik bidvarim shehen meinyan devarim shemmevarchin alav eno tzarich levarech sheniyya. ketzad. kegon shebberech al happat vekodem sheyyochal amar haviu melach haviu tavshil tenu lifloni leechol tenu maachol labbehema vechayyotze baellu eno tzarich levarech shenit. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Kol habberachot kullam muttar letame levarech otan. ben shehaya tame tuma shehu yachol laalot mimmenna bo bayyom. ben tuma sheeno yachol laalot mimmenna bo bayyom. veasur lamvarech levarech keshehu arom ad sheyyechasse ervato. bamme devarim amurim beish aval beishsha yoshevet ufaneha tuchot bakkarka umevarechet:

Kol habberachot kullan af al pi shebberech veyatza yede chovato muttar lo levarech laacherim shello yatzu yede chovatan kede lehotzian. chutz mibbirkat hahanaya sheen bah mitzva sheeno mevarech laacherim ella im ken nehena immahen. aval birkat hahanaya sheyyesh bah mitzva kegon achilat matztza belele happesachim vekiddush hayyom hare ze mevarech laacherim veochlin veshotim af al pi sheeno ochel immahen:

Kol hashshomea beracha min habberachot mittechillatah vead sofah venitkavven latzet bah yede chovato yatza veaf al pi shello ana amen. vechol haone amen achar hamevarech hare ze kimvarech vehu sheyyihye hamevarech chayyav beotah beracha. haya hamevarech chayyav middivre sofrim vehaone chayyav min hattora lo yatza yede chovato ad sheyyaane o ad sheyyishma mimmi shehu chayyav bah min hattora kamohu:

Rabbim shennitvaadu leechol pat o lishtot yayin uverech echad mehen veanu kullam amen hare ellu muttarin leechol velishtot. aval im lo nitkavvenu leechol keechad ella ze ba meatzmo veze ba meatzmo af al pi shehen ochlin mikkikkar echad kol echad veechad mevarech leatzmo. bamme devarim amurim befat veyayin bilvad aval shear ochalim umashkin enan tzerichin hassibba ella im berech echad mehen veanu kullan amen hare ellu ochlim veshotin. veaf al pi shello nitkavvenu lehasev keechad:

Kol hashshomea echad miyyisrael mevarech beracha mikkol habberachot kullan af al pi shello shama habberacha kullah mittechillatah vead sofah veaf al pi sheeno chayyav beotah beracha chayyav laanot amen. veim haya hamevarech goy o eppikoros o kuti o tinok hammitlammed o shehaya gadol veshinna mimmatbea habberacha en onin acharehen amen:

Kol haone amen lo yaane lo amen chatufa velo amen ketufa velo amen ketzara velo arukka ella amen benonit. velo yagbiah kolo yoter min hamevarech. vechol mi shello shama et habberacha shehu chayyav bah lo yaane amen bichlal haonim:

Kol hamevarech beracha sheenah tzericha hare ze nose shem shamayim lashshav vahare hu kenishba lashshav veasur laanot acharav amen. hattinokot melammedin otan habberachot ketikkunan veaf al pi shehen mevarchin levattala bishat limmud hare ze muttar. veen onin acharehen amen. vehaone acharehen amen lo yatza yede chovato:

Kol haone amen achar birchotav hare ze megunne. vehaone achar beracha shehi sof berachot acharonot hare ze meshubbach. kegon achar bone yerushalayim bevirkat hammazon veachar beracha acharona shel keriat shema shel arvit. vechen besof kol beracha shehi sof berachot acharonot one bah amen achar atzmo:

Velamma yaane amen achar bone yerushalayim vahare achareha birkat hattov vehammetiv. mippene shebberacha zo bime chachme mishna tikkenuha ucheillu hi tosefet. aval sof ikkar habberachot shel birkat hammazon hi bone yerushalayim. velamma lo yaane amen achar ahavat olam mippene shehi sof berachot rishonot shel keriat shema, vechen kol kayyotze bah mibberachot shemmevarchin otan techilla laddavar, kegon berachot shemmevarchin lifne keriat megilla vehadelakat ner chanukka. lemaan lo yafsik beamen ben beracha uven haddavar shebberech alav:

Velamma lo yaane amen achar birkat happerot vechayyotze bah. mippene shehi beracha achat veen onin amen ella achar beracha acharona shekkadma otah beracha acheret o berachot kegon birchot hammelech uvirchot kohen gadol vechayyotze bahen, lehodia shekkevar hishlim kol birchotav ulefichach one amen:

Kol haochel davar haasur ben bezadon ben bishgaga eno mevarech alav lo battechilla velo bassof. ketzad. hare sheachal tevel shel divrehem o sheachal maaser rishon shello nittelu terumotav o maaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu kehilchatan eno mevarech. veen tzarich lomar im achal nevelot uterefot o shata yen nesech vechayyotze bo:

Aval im achal demay af al pi sheeno rauy ella laaniyyim o maaser rishon shennittela terumato af al pi shello nittal mimmennu cheshbon teruma gedola vehu shehikdimo beshibbolin, o maaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu af al pi shello natan et hachomesh. hare ze mevarech techilla vasof. vechen kol keyotze bahen:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 2: Seder birkat hammazon kach hi. rishona birkat hazzan. sheniyya birkat haaretz. shelishit bone yerushalayim. reviit hattov vehammetiv. beracha rishona moshe rabbenu tikkenah. sheniyya tikken yehoshua. shelishit tikken david ushelomo beno. reviit chachme mishna tikkenuha:

Happoalim shehayu osin melacha etzel baal habbayit veachlu pittan en mevarchin lefaneha. umevarchin leachar seuddatan shete berachot bilvad kede shello yevattelu melechet baal habbayit. beracha rishona ketikkunah. sheniyya poteach bevirkat haaretz vecholel bah bone yerushalayim vechotem bevirkat haaretz. veim hayu osin bisuddatan bilvad o shehaya baal habbayit mesev immahen mevarchin arba berachot ketikkunan kishar kol adam:

Birkat haaretz tzarich lomar hodaya bitchillatah uvesofah vechotem bah al haaretz veal hammazon. vechol shello amar eretz chemda tova urechava bevirkat haaretz lo yatza yede chovato. vetzarich lehazekir bah berit vetora ulehakdim berit letora. shehabberit hazzot sheomrim bevirkat haaretz hi berit mila shennichretu aleha shelosh esre beritot vehattora kullah nichretu aleha shalosh beritot shenneemar <small>(Devarim 28 69)</small> "elle divre habberit" vegomer, <small>(Devarim 28 69)</small> "millevad habberit asher karat ittam bechorev", <small>(Devarim 29 9)</small> "attem nitztzavim" vegomer <small>(Devarim 29 11)</small> "leavrecha bivrit" vegomer:

Beracha shelishit poteach bah rachem Adonai elohenu alenu veal yisrael ammecha veal yerushalayim irecha veal tziyyon mishkan kevodecha. o nachamenu Adonai elohenu birushalayim irecha vechotem bah bone yerushalayim o menachem ammo yisrael bevinyan yerushalayim. ulefichach nikret beracha zo nechama. vechol mi shello amar malchut bet david bivracha zo lo yatza yede chovato mippene shehi inyan habberacha, sheen nechama gemura ella bachazarat malchut bet david:

Beshabbatot uveyamim tovim matchil benechama umesayyem benechama veomer kedushshat hayyom baemtza. ketzad matchil. nachamenu Adonai elohenu betziyyon irecha o rachem Adonai elohenu al yisrael ammecha veal yerushalayim irecha. umesayyem menachem ammo yisrael bevinyan yerushalayim o bone yerushalayim. veomer baemtza beshabbat elohenu velohe avotenu retze vehachalitzenu Adonai elohenu bemitzvotecha uvemitzvat yom hashshevii haggadol vehakkadosh hazze ki yom ze gadol vekadosh hu millefanecha nishbot bo venanuach bo beahava kemitzvat retzonecha birtzoncha hanach lanu Adonai elohenu veal tehe alenu tzara veraa veyagon vaanacha beyom menuchatenu. uveyamim tovim omer yaale veyavo. vechen berashe chodashim uvechullo shel moed mosif beemtza beracha shelishit yaale veyavo:

Bachanukka uvefurim mosif beemtza birkat haaretz al hannissim kederech shemmosif battefilla. veyom tov o rosh chodesh shechal lihyot beshabbat mazkir retze vehachalitzenu techilla veachar kach yaale veyavo. vechen rosh chodesh tevet shechal lihyot beshabbat mazkir al hannissim bevirkat haaretz uretze vehachalitzenu veyaale veyavo benechama:

Beracha reviit tzarich lehazekir bah shalosh malchuyyot. ucheshemmevarech haoreach etzel baal habbayit mosif bah beracha levaal habbayit. ketzad. omer yehi ratzon shello yevosh baal habbayit baolam hazze velo yikkalem laolam habba vechulei. veyesh lo reshut lehosif bevirkat baal habbayit ulehaarich bah:

Ucheshemmevarchin bevet haavel omer bivracha reviit hammelech hachay hattov vehammetiv el emet dayan emet shofet betzedek shallit beolamo laasot bo kirtzono sheanachnu ammo vaavadav uvakkol anachnu chayyavin lehodot lo ulevarcho. umevakkesh rachamim al haavel lenachamo kefi ma sheyyirtze. vegomer harachaman kulei:

Bevet chatanim mevarchin birkat chatanim achar arba berachot ellu bechol seudda useudda sheochlim sham. veen mevarchin beracha zo lo avadim velo ketannim. ad kamma mevarchin beracha zo. im haya almon shennasa almana mevarchin otah beyom rishon bilvad. veim bachur shennasa almana o almon shennasa betula mevarchin otah kol shivat yeme hammishte:

Beracha zo shemmosifin bevet chatanim hi beracha acharona mishsheva berachot shel nissuin. bamme devarim amurim keshehayu haochlin hem sheamdu bevirkat nissuin veshamu habberachot aval im hayu haochlin acherim shello shamu birkat nissuin bishat nissuin mevarchin bishvilam achar birkat mazon sheva berachot kederech shemmevarchin bishat nissuin. vehu sheyyihyu asara. vachatanim min hamminyan:

Veellu hen sheva berachot. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam yotzer haadam. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam shehakkol bara lichvodo. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher yatzar et haadam betzalmo betzelem demut tavnito vehitkin lo mimmennu binyan ade ad baruch atta Adonai yotzer haadam. sos tasis vetagel akara bekibbutz baneha letochah besimcha baruch [atta] Adonai mesammeach tziyyon bevaneha. sammeach tesammach reim vaahuvim kesammechacha yetzircha began eden mikkedem baruch atta Adonai mesammeach chatan vechalla. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher bara sason vesimcha chatan vechalla gila verinna ditza vechedva ahava achava shalom vereut mehera Adonai elohenu yishshama beare yehuda uvechutzot yerushalayim kol sason vekol simcha kol chatan vekol kalla kol mitzhalot chatanim [mechuppatam] unearim minneginatam baruch atta Adonai mesammeach chatan im hakkalla:

Shachach velo hizkir beshabbat o beyom tov kedushshat hayyom. im nizkar kodem sheyyatchil bivracha reviit beshabbat omer baruch Adonai asher natan menucha leammo yisrael leot velivrit kodesh baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh hashshabbat. beyom tov omer baruch asher natan yamim tovim leammo yisrael lesashon ulesimcha baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim. umatchil bevirkat reviit vegomer. veim nizkar achar shehitchil bivracha reviit posek vechozer larosh shehu birkat hazzan:

Berashe chodashim shachach velo amar yaale veyavo im nizkar kodem sheyyatchil beracha reviit omer baruch asher natan rashe chodashim leammo yisrael lezikkaron veeno chotem bah umatchil bivracha reviit vegomer. veim nizkar achar shehitchil bivracha reviit gomer otah veeno chozer. vechen bechullo shel moed uvachanukka uvefurim, shachach velo hizkir hainyan bevirkat hammazon eno chozer:

Mi sheachal veshachach velo berech. im nizkar kodem sheyyitakkel hammaachol shebbemeav chozer umevarech. nitakkel hammazon shebbemeav eno chozer umevarech. vechen im neelam mimmennu velo yada im berech o lo berech chozer umevarech vehu shello nitakkel hammazon shebbemeav:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 3: Chamishsha minin hen. hachittin vehasseorin vehakkussemin veshibbolet shual veshippon. hakkussemin mimmin hachittin veshibbolet shual veshippon mimmin hasseorim. vachamishsha minin haellu keshehen shibbolim nikraim tevua bechol makom. veachar sheddashin vezorin otan nikrain dagan. ucheshettochanin otan velashin et kimchan veofin otan nikrain pat. vehappat hannaase meechad mehen hi hannikret pat bechol makom belo liuuy:

Haochel pat chayyav levarech lefaneha baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hammotzi lechem min haaretz. uleachareha arba berachot. achal dagan shaluk kemo shehu mevarech lefanav bore peri haadama. uleacharav bore nefashot rabbot. achal kemach mevarech lefanav shehakkol uleacharav bore nefashot rabbot:

Kemach shel echad mechameshet hamminin sheshshelakuhu veervu bemayim o bishar mashkim im haya ave kede sheyyihye rauy laachila ulelooso mevarech alav battechilla bore mine mezonot ulevassof al hammichya veal hakkalkala. veim haya rach kede sheyyihye rauy lishtiyya mevarech alav battechilla shehakkol ulevassof bore nefashot rabbot:

Kemach shel echad mechameshet hamminin shebbishshelo bikdera ben levaddo ben sheervo im devarim acherim kegon levivot vechayyotze bahen. vechen haddagan shechilleko o ketasho uvishshelo bikdera kegon harifot vegeres hakkarmel vechayyotze bahen vechol ze hu hannikra maase kedera. vechen kol tavshil sheerev bo mechameshet hamminin ben kemach ben pat. battechilla mevarech alav bore mine mezonot:

Bamme devarim amurim keshehaya hammin hazze chashuv etzlo velo haya tefela. aval im haya echad mechameshet hamminin sheerev tefela eno mevarech ella al haikkar ufoter et hattefela. veze kelal bivrachot kol shehu ikkar veimmo tefela mevarech al haikkar ufoter et hattefela ben shehayta hattefela meorevet im haikkar ben shello hayta meorevet:

Ketzad hi hattefela hameorevet. kegon lefet o keruv shebbishshelo veerev bo kemach shel echad mechameshet hamminin kede ledabbeko eno mevarech alav bore mine mezonot shehallefet hu haikkar vekimcho tefela. shekkol davar shemmearvin oto ledabbek o kede litten reach o kede litzboa et hattavshil hare zo tefela. aval im erev kede litten taam battaarovot hare hu ikkar. lefichach mine devash shemmevashshelin otan venotnin bahen chelev chitta kede ledabbek veosin mehen mine metika eno mevarech alav bore mine mezonot mippene shehaddevash hu haikkar:

Ketzad hi hattefela sheenah meorevet. hare shetztzarich leechol dag maliach veachal happat immo kede shello yazzik hammelach gerono uleshono hare ze mevarech al hammaliach ufoter et happat mippene shehappat tefela lo. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Happat sheppatat otah pittim uvishlah bikdera o lashah bemarak. im yesh bappetitin kezayit o shenikkar shehen pat velo nishtanna tzuratah mevarech aleha battechilla hammotzi. veim en bahen kezayit o sheubbera tzurat happat babbishshul mevarech aleha battechilla bore mine mezonot:

Issa shenneefet bakkarka kemo shehaarviyyim shochne hammidbarot ofim hoil veen aleha tzurat pat mevarech aleha battechilla bore mine mezonot. veim kava mezono aleha mevarech hammotzi. vechen issa shellashah bidvash o beshemen o bechalav o sheerev bah mine tavlin vaafaah vehi hannikret pat habbaa bechisnin af al pi shehu pat mevarech aleha bore mine mezonot. veim kava seuddato aleha mevarech hammotzi:

Orez shebbishshelo o sheasa mimmennu pat battechilla mevarech alav bore mine mezonot ulevassof bore nefashot. uvilvad shello yehe meorav im davar acher ella orez levaddo. aval pat dochan o pat shel shear mine kitnit battechilla mevarech shehakkol ulevassof bore nefashot rabbot:

Kol shemmevarchin alav battechilla hammotzi mevarchin leacharav bassof birkat hammazon kesidrah arba berachot. vechol shemmevarchin alav battechilla bore mine mezonot mevarchin bassof leacharav beracha achat meen shalosh chutz min haorez:

Bamme devarim amurim sheachal mikkezayit ulemala aval achal pachot mikkezayit ben min happat ben mishshear ochlin. vehashshote pachot merviit ben min hayyayin ben mishshear mashkin. mevarech battechilla beracha haruya leoto hammin ulevassof eno mevarech kelal:

Vezo hi beracha achat meen shalosh. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam al hammichya veal hakkalkala veal eretz chemda tova urechava sheratzita veshehinchalta et avotenu rachem Adonai elohenu alenu veal yisrael ammecha veal yerushalayim irecha veal tziyyon mishkan kevodecha vehaalenu letochah vesammechenu bevinyanah unevarechcha aleha bikdushsha uvetohora baruch atta Adonai al haaretz veal hammichya. uveshabbatot veyamim tovim omer bivracha zo bichlalah meen kedushshat hayyom kederech shemmazkir bevirkat hammazon:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 4: Kol hamevarech birkat hammazon o beracha achat meen shalosh tzarich levarech otah bammakom sheachal. achal keshehu mehallech yoshev bemakom sheppasak vivarech. achal keshehu omed yoshev bimkomo vivarech. shachach levarech birkat hammazon venizkar kodem sheyyitakkel hammazon shebbemeav mevarech bammakom shennizkar. veim haya mezid chozer limkomo umevarech. veim berech bammakom shennizkar yatza yede chovato. vechen im berech keshehu omed o keshehu mehallech yatza yede chovato. ulechattechilla lo yevarech birkat hammazon velo beracha shemmeen shalosh ella keshehu yoshev uvammakom sheachal:

Mi shennistappek lo im berech hammotzi o lo berech hammotzi eno chozer umevarech mippene sheeno min hattora. shachach levarech hammotzi. im nizkar ad shello gamar seuddato chozer umevarech veim nizkar leachar sheggamar eno chozer umevarech:

Haya ochel bevayit ze ufasak seuddato vehalach levayit acher. o shehaya ochel ukeraahu chavero ledabber immo veyatza lo lefetach beto vechazar hoil veshinna mekomo tzarich levarech lemafrea al ma sheachal vechozer umevarech battechilla hammotzi veachar kach yigmor seuddato:

Chaverim shehayu yoshvim leechol veyatzu likrat chatan o likrat kalla. im hinnichu sham zaken o chole chozrin limkoman vegomrin seuddatan veenan tzerichin levarech sheniyya. veim lo hinnichu sham adam keshehen yotzin tzerichin beracha lemafrea ucheshehen chozrin tzerichin beracha lechattechilla:

Vechen im hayu mesubbin bishtiyya o leechol perot. shekkol hameshanne mekomo hare pasak achilato ulefichach mevarech lemafrea al ma sheachal vechozer umevarech sheniyya lechattechilla al ma shehu tzarich leechol. vehameshanne mekomo mippinna lefinna bevayit echad eno tzarich lachazor ulevarech. achal bemizrachah shel teena uva leechol bemaaravah tzarich lachazor ulevarech:

Berech al happat patar et happarperet sheochlin bahen happat mimmine hattavshil uferot vechayyotze bahen. aval im berech al happarperet lo patar et happat. berech al maase kedera patar et hattavshil berech al hattavshil lo patar et maase kedera:

Gamar belibbo milleechol o millishtot veachar kach nimlach leechol o lishtot af al pi shello shinna mekomo chozer umevarech. veim lo gamar belibbo ella dato lachazor leechol velishtot afillu pasak kol hayyom kullo eno tzarich levarech shenit:

Hayu shotin veamru bou unevarech birkat hammazon o bou unekaddesh kiddush hayyom neesar alehem lishtot ad sheyyevarchu o yekaddeshu. veim ratzu lachazor velishtot kodem sheyyevarchu o yekaddeshu af al pi sheenam rashshaim tzerichim lachazor ulevarech techilla bore peri haggafen veachar kach yishtu. aval im amru bou venavdil en tzerichin lachazor ulevarech:

Hayu mesubbin lishtot yayin uva lahen min yayin acher kegon shehayu shotin adom veheviu shachor o yashan veheviu chadash enan tzerichin levarech birkat hayyayin paam sheniyya. aval mevarchin baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hattov vehammetiv:

En mevarchin al ochel min kol hoochalin velo al mashke min kol hammashkin ad sheyyavo lefanav. veim berech veachar kach hevio lefanav tzarich lachazor ulevarech. natal ochel uverech alav venafal miyyado venisraf o shetafo nahar notel acher vechozer umevarech alav af al pi shehu meoto hammin. vetzarich lomar baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed al beracha rishona kede shello lehotzi shem shamayim levattala. omed adam al ammat hammayim umevarech veshote af al pi shehammayim shehayu lefanav bishat habberacha enam hammayim sheshshata mippene shellechach nitkavven techilla:

Devarim habbaim betoch hasseudda vehen mechamat hasseudda enan tzerichin beracha lifnehem velo leacharehem ella birkat hammotzi shebbattechilla uvirkat hammazon shebbassof poteret hakkol shehakkol tefela lasseudda. udevarim sheenan mechamat hasseudda shebbau betoch hasseudda teunin beracha lifnehem velo leacharehem. udevarim habbaim leachar hasseudda ben mechamat hasseudda ben shello mechamat hasseudda teunin beracha lifnehen uleacharehem:

Beshabbatot uveyamim tovim uvisudat hakkazat haddam uveshaa sheyyatza min hammerchatz vechayyotze bahen sheadam kovea seuddato al hayyayin. im berech al hayyayin shellifne hammazon patar et hayyayin sheshshata leachar hammazon kodem sheyyevarech birkat hammazon. aval bishar hayyamim tzarich lachazor ulevarech battechilla al hayyayin shel achar hammazon. ba lahen yayin betoch hammazon kol echad veechad mevarech leatzmo sheen bet habbelia panuy sheyyaanu amen veeno poter et hayyayin shelleachar hammazon:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 5: Nashim vaavadim chayyavin bevirkat hammazon. vesafek yesh baddavar im hen chayyavin min hattora lefi sheen kavua lah zeman o enam chayyavin min hattora. lefichach en motziin et haggedolim yede chovatan. aval hakketannim chayyavin bevirkat hammazon middivre sofrim kede lechannechan bemitzvot:

Shelosha sheachlu pat keechad chayyavin levarech birkat hazzimmun kodem birkat hammazon. vee zo hi birkat hazzimmun. im hayu haochlim mishshelosha ad asara mevarech echad mehem veomer nevarech sheachalnu mishshello vehakkol onin baruch sheachalnu mishshello uvetuvo chayinu. vehu chozer umevarech baruch sheachalnu mishshello uvetuvo chayinu:
Veachar kach omer baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hazzan et haolam kullo betuvo ad sheggomer arba berachot. vehen onin amen achar kol beracha uveracha:

Hayu haochlin measara ulemala mezammenin beshem. ketzad. hamevarech omer nevarech lelohenu sheachalnu mishshello. vehen onin baruch elohenu sheachalnu mishshello uvetuvo chayinu. vehu chozer veomer baruch elohenu sheachalnu mishshello uvetuvo chayinu. umatchil birkat hammazon:

Hassoed bevet chatanim mishsheyyatchilu lehitassek betzarche seuddat nissuin velahachinah ad sheloshim yom achar hannissuin mevarech nevarech shehassimcha bimono sheachalnu mishshello. vehem onim baruch shehassimcha bimono sheachalnu mishshello vechulei. veim hayu asara mevarech nevarech lelohenu shehassimcha bimono sheachalnu mishshello. vehem onin baruch elohenu shehassimcha vechulei. vechen seudda sheosin otah achar hannissuin mechamat hannissuin ad shenem asar chodesh mevarech shehassimcha bimono:

Hakkol chayyavin bevirkat hazzimmun kederech shechayyavin bevirkat hammazon. afillu kohanim sheachlu kadshe hakkadashim baazara. vechen kohanim veyisreelim sheachlu keechad veachlu hakkohanim teruma veyisrael chullin chayyavin bezimmun kechiyyuvan bevirkat hammazon:

Nashim vaavadim uketannim en mezammenin alehen aval mezammenin leatzman. velo tehe chavura shel nashim vaavadim uketannim mippene happeritzut. aval nashim mezammenot leatzman o avadim leatzman uvilvad shello yezammenu beshem. anderoginus mezammen lemino veeno mezammen lo lenashim velo laanashim mippene shehu safek. vehattumtum eno mezammen kelal. katan hayyodea lemi mevarchin mezammenin alav veaf al pi shehu keven sheva o keven shemone. umitztaref ben leminyan shelosha ben leminyan asara lezammen alav. vehannachri en mezammenin alav:

En mezammenin ella al mi sheachal kezayit pat ulemala. shiva sheachlu pat ushelosha achlu immahen yarak o tzir vechayyotze bahen mitztarfin lezammen beshem. vehu sheyyihye hamevarech meochle happat. aval shishsha sheachlu pat vearbaa yarak en mitztarfin ad sheyyihyu ochle happat rov hannikkar. bamme devarim amurim baasara. aval bishlosha tzarich sheyyochlu kol echad veechad mehen kezayit pat veachar kach mezammenin:

Shenayim sheachlu vegamru milleechol uva shelishi veachal. im yecholin leechol immo kol shehu vaafillu mishshear ochalin mitztaref immahen. vechacham gadol shebbamsubbin hu shemmevarech lechullan af al pi shello ba ella baacharona:

Shelosha sheachlu keechad enan rashshain lechalek. vechen arbaa vechen chamishsha. veshishsha yesh lahem lechalek ad asara. measara ulemala enam rashshaim lechalek ad esrim. shekkol zeman sheyyechalku vetihye birkat hazzimmun lechol chelek vechelek kezimmun hakkol yesh lahem lechalek:

Shelosha bene adam shebbau mishshalosh chavurot shel shelosha shelosha enan rashshain lechalek. veim kevar zimmen kol echad veechad mehen bachavura shello rashshain lechalek. veenan chayyavin bezimmun shekkevar zimmenu alehen. shelosha sheyyashvu leechol pat af al pi shekkol echad veechad ochel mishshello enan rashshain lechalek:

Shete chavurot shehayu ochlin bevayit echad. bizman shemmiktzatan roin ellu et ellu mitztarfin lezimmun echad. veim lav ellu mezammenin leatzman veellu mezammenin leatzman. veim yesh shammash echad benehem shehu holech umeshammesh mechavura zo lachavura zo mitztarfin lezimmun echad af al pi sheen miktzat ellu roin et ellu. vehu sheyyishmeu shetehen kol divre hamevarech beveur:

Shelosha sheachlu veyatza echad mehen lashshuk korin lo kede sheyyechavven lishmoa ma shehen omrim umezammenin alav vehu bashshuk veyotze yede chovato. velichsheyyachazor leveto yachazor vivarech birkat hammazon leatzmo aval asara sheachlu veyatza echad mehen lashshuk en mezammenin alav ad sheyyachazor limkomo veyeshev immahen:
Shelosha sheachlu keechad vekadam echad mehen uverech leatzmo mezammenin alav veyatzu hashshenayim yede chovat zimmun vehu lo yatza bezimmun ze sheen zimmun lemafrea:

Shenayim sheachlu keechad kol echad veechad mevarech leatzmo. veim haya echad mehen yodea veechad eno yodea ze sheyyodea mevarech bekol ram vehashsheni one amen achar kol beracha uveracha veyotze yede chovato. uven mevarech leaviv. veeved mevarech lerabbo. veishsha mevarechet levalah. veyotzin yede chovatan. aval amru chachamim tavo meera lemi sheishto uvanav mevarchin lo:

Bamme devarim amurim sheyyatzu yede chovatan bizman sheachlu velo savu shehen chayyavim levarech middivre sofrim ulefichach motziin otan katan o eved o ishsha mide chovatan. aval im achal vesava shehu chayyav bevirkat hammazon min hattora. ben ishsha ben katan o eved en motziin otan. shekkol hachayyav bedavar min hattora en motziin otan mide chovatan ella hachayyav beoto davar min hattora kemoto:

Hannichnas etzel acherim umetzaan mevarchin bevirkat hazzimmun. im matza hamevarech omer nevarech hu one baruch hu umevorach. veim matza haochlim onin baruch sheachalnu mishshello hu one acharehen amen:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 6: Kol haochel happat shemmevarchin alav hammotzi tzarich netilat yadayim techilla vasof. veaf al pi shehi pat chullin veaf al pi sheen yadav meluchlachot veeno yodea lahen tuma lo yochal ad sheyyittol shete yadav. vechen kol davar shettibbulo bemashkin tzarich netilat yadayim techilla:

Kol hannotel yadav ben laachila ben likriat shema ben litfilla mevarech techilla asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al netilat yadayim. shezzo mitzvat chachamim shennitztavvenu min hattora lishmoa mehen shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 11)</small> "al pi hattora asher yorucha". vmayim acharonim en mevarchin alehen sheenam ella mippene hassakkana. ulefichach chayyav adam lehizzaher bahen beyoter:

Netilat yadayim ben tavshil letavshil reshut. ratza notel ratza eno notel. uferot shel chullin enan tzerichin netilat yadayim ben battechilla ben bassof. vechol hannotel yadav leferot hare ze miggasse haruach. kol pat shehammelach bo tzarich netilat yadayim baacharona shemma yesh bo melach sedomit o melach shettivo kemelach sedomit veyaavir yadav al enav visamme. mippene ze chayyavin littol yadayim besof kol seudda mippene hammelach. uvemachane peturim minnetilat yadayim battechilla mippene shehen terudim bemilchama. vechayyavin baacharona mippene hassakkana:
Ad hechan hi netilat yadayim. ad happerek. vechamma shiur hammayim. reviit lechol shete yadayim. vechol shechotztzim bitvila chotzetz bintilat yadayim. vechol haole lemiddat mikve ole leshiur reviit:

Kol hatztzarich netilat yadayim vehitbil yadav beme mikve eno tzarich davar acher. veim hitbilan bemayim sheen bahem shiur mikve o bemayim sheuvin shebbakkarka lo asa kelum sheen hammayim sheuvin metaharin et hayyadayim ella bintila:

Kol hannotel yadav tzarich lehizzaher bearbaa devarim. bammayim atzman shello yihyu pesulin lintilat yadayim. uvashshiur sheyyihye bahen reviit lechol shete yadayim. uvakkeli sheyyihyu hammayim shennotlin bahen bichli. uvenotel sheyyihyu hammayim bain mikkoach noten:

Arbaa devarim poslin et hammayim. shinnuy mare. vegilluy. vaasiyyat melacha bahen. vehefsed shemmonea et habbehema millishtot mehen. ketzad. mayim shennishtannu maritan ben bechelim ben bekarkaot ben mechamat davar shennafal letochan ben mechamat mekoman hare ellu pesulin. vechen im nitgallu gilluy haoser otan mishshetiyya nifselu lintilat yadayim:

Kol mayim shennaasa bahen melacha naasu shofchin ufesulin lintilat yadayim. ketzad. mayim sheuvin shehediach bahen kelim o sheshshara bahem pitto vechayyotze beze ben bechelim ben bekarkaot pesulin lintilat yadayim. hediach bahen kelim mudachin o chadashim lo pesalan. mayim shehannachtom metabbel bahen et hakkeachim pesulin. veshehu chofen mehen bishat lisha kesherim. shehammayim shebbechafnav hen shennaasu bahen melacha. aval hammayim shechofen mehem hare hen bechashrutan:

Vechol mayim shennifselu mishshetiyyat kelev. kegon shehayu marim o meluchim o achurin o reach ra ad shello yishte mehen hakkelev. bechelim pesulin lintilat yadayim uvekarkaot kesherim lehatebil. chamme teverya bimkoman matbilin bahem et hayyadayim. aval im natal mehen bichli o shehiflig mehen amma lemakom acher en notlin mehen lo rishonim velo acharonim mippene sheenan reuyin lishtiyyat behema:

Yesh lannotel litten al yadav meat meat ad sheyyitten kashshiur. veim natan harviit kullah bishtifa achat kasher. notlin arbaa o chamishsha ze betzad ze o yad ze al gabbe ze bishtifa achat. uvilvad sheyyarpu yedehen kede sheyyavo benehen hammayim. veyihye beotah hashshetifa kede reviit lechol echad veechad:

En notlin mayim layyadayim lo bedafnot hakkelim velo beshule hammachatz velo bacharasim velo bimgufat hechavit. veim tikken hammegufa lintila notlin mimmenna layyadayim. vechen hachemet shettikkenah notlin mimmenna layyadayim. aval sak vekuppa shennitkenu en notlin mehen layyadayim. velo yitten lachavero bechafnav sheen chafnav keli. vechelim shennishberu shevira hametaheret otan mide tuma en notnin bahem layyadayim mippene shehen shivre kelim:
Bechol hakkelim notlim layyadayim vaafillu kele gelalim uchele adama. vehu sheyyihyu shelemim. keli sheeno machazik reviit o en bo reviit en notnin mimmenna layyadayim:

Hakkol kesherin litten layyadayim afillu cheresh shote vekatan. im en sham acher manniach hakkeli ben birkav vetzak al yadav. o yatte hechavit al yadav veyittol. o notel yado achat vetzak bezo al zo vechozer vetzak barishona al hashsheniyya. vehakkof notel layyadayim:

Hashshoket sheddole adam beyado o begalgal venoten letochah vehammayim nimshachin mimmenna baamma veholchin umashkin hayerakot o habbehema vehinniach yadav bashshoket veavru hammayim veshatfu al yadav lo alta lo netila. shehare en kan noten al yadav. veim hayu yadav kerovot lishfichat haddeli ad shennimtzeu hammayim shatfu al yadav mikkoach netinat haadam alta lo netila:

Mayim shennistappek lo im naasa mehen melacha o lo naasa. im yesh bahen kashshiur o sheen bahen. im hen tehorin o temein. safek natal yadav safek lo natal yadav. sefeko tahor shekkol safek shebbetohorat yadayim tahor:

Mayim harishonim tzarich sheyyagbiah yadav lemala ad shello yetzu mayim chutz lapperek veyachzeru vitammeu et hayyadayim. veacharonim tzarich sheyyashpil yadav lematta kede sheyyetze kol koach hammelach meal yadav. mayim rishonim nittalim ben al gabbe keli ben al gabbe karka. veacharonim enan nittalin ella al gabbe keli. mayim rishonim nittalin ben bechamme haur ben betzonen. veacharonim enan nittalin bechammin. vehu sheyyihyu chammim shehayyad soledet bahen mippene sheen maavirin et hazzuhama, sheeno yachol leshafshef bahen. aval hayu poshrin notlin mehen baacharona:

Notel adam yadav shacharit umatne alehen kol hayyom veeno tzarich littol et yadav lechol achila vaachila. vehu shello yassiach dato mehen. aval im hissiach dato mehen tzarich littol yadav bechol et shetztzarich netila:

Lat adam et yadav bemappa veochel bahen pat o davar shettibbulo bemashke af al pi shello natal yadav. hammaachil laacherim eno tzarich netilat yadayim. vehaochel tzarich netilat yadayim af al pi sheacher noten letoch piv veeno nogea bammaachol. vehu haddin leochel bemagrefa shetztzarich netilat yadayim:

Asur lehaachil mi shello natal yadav veaf al pi shehu noten letoch piv. veasur lezalzel bintilat yadayim. vetziuuyim harebe tziuu chachamim vehizhiru al haddavar. afillu en lo mayim ella kede shetiyya notel yadav bemiktzatan veachar kach ochel veshote miktzatan:

Tzarich adam lenaggev et yadav veachar kach yochal. vechol haochel belo nigguv yadayim keochel lechem tame. vechol hannotel yadav baacharona menaggev veachar kach mevarech. vetechef lintilat yadayim birkat hammazon, lo yafsik benehem bedavar acher. afillu lishtot mayim achar shennotel yadav baacharona asur ad sheyyevarech birkat hammazon:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 7: Minhagot rabbot nahagu chachme yisrael basseudda vechullan derech eretz. veellu hen. keshennichnasin lasseudda haggadol shebbechullan notel et yadav techilla. veachar kach nichnasin veyoshvin mesubbin. vegadol mesev barosh vesheni lo lematta hemennu. hayu shelosha mittot gadol mesev barosh vesheni lo lemala hemennu ushelishi lo lematta hemennu:

Baal habbayit mevarech hammotzi umashlim habberacha veachar kach botzea. vehaoreach mevarech birkat hammazon kede sheyyevarech levaal habbayit. veim hayu kullan baale habbayit haggadol shebbahen botzea vehu mevarech birkat hammazon:

En habbotzea rashshay livtzoa ad sheyyaviu melach o liftan lifne kol echad veechad ella im ken nitkavvenu leechol pat chareva. veeno botzea lo perusa ketanna mippene shehu nire ketzar ayin velo perusa gedola yoter mikkevetza mippene shennire kiravtan. uveshabbat yesh lo livtzoa perusa gedola. veeno botzea ella mimmakom shennitbashshel yafe yafe:

Mitzva min hammuvchar livtzoa kikkar shelema. im hayta sham shelema shel seorim uferusa shel chittim manniach shelema betoch perusa uvotzea mishshetehen kede sheyyivtza mechittim umishshelema. beshabbatot uveyamim tovim chayyav livtzoa al shete kikkarot notel shetehen beyado uvotzea achat mehen:

Habbotzea noten perusa lifne kol echad veechad. vehaacher notel beyado. veen habbotzea noten beyad haochel ella im ken haya avel. vehabbotzea hu poshet yadav techilla veochel. veen hammesubbin rashshain litom ad sheyyitom hamevarech. veen habbotzea rashshay litom ad sheyyichle amen mippi rov hammesubbin. veim ratza habbotzea lachalok kavod lerabbo o lemi shehu gadol mimmennu bechachma veyannichennu lifshot yado kodem lo harshut beyado:

Shenayim mamtinin ze laze bikara. shelosha en mamtinin. gamru mehen shenayim hashshelishi mafsik immahen. gamar echad mehen hashshenayim en mafsikin lo ella ochlin veholchin ad sheggomrin. en mesichin bisudda kede shello yavo lide sakkana. umippene ze im ba lahem yayin betoch hammazon kol echad veechad mevarech leatzmo. sheim berech echad veone haone amen bishat habbelia yavo lide sakkana. veen mistakkelin bifne haochel velo limnato shello levayyesho:

Hashshammash sheomed lifne hammesubbin eno ochel immahen. vederech rachamanut hu litten letoch piv mikkol tavshil vetavshil kede leyashshev dato. veim natnu lo yayin mevarech al kol kos vechos shennotnin lo. mippene sheen shetiyyato teluya birtzono ella birtzonam:

Yatza echad min hammesubbin lehashetin mayim notel yado achat venichnas. dibber im chavero vehiflig notel shete yadav venichnas. im hayu mesubbin lishtiyya nichnas veyoshev bimkomo venotel yadav veachar kach machazir panav laorchin. velamma notel bimkomo shemma yomru lo natal yadav mippene sheen sham achila:

En mannichin basar chay al happat. veen maavirin kos male al happat. veen somchin et hakkeara befat. veen zorkin et happat. velo et hachatichot velo et hoochalin sheen lahen kelippin kegon tutim vaanavim uteenim mippene shehen nimasin. umuttar limshoch et hayyayin betzinnorot bevatte chatanim vezorkin lifnehem kelayot veegozim bimot hachamma aval lo bimot haggeshamim mippene shennimasin. veen notlin yedehen beyayin ben chay ben mazug. vechen en mafsidin shear ochalin umashkin derech bizzuy uveita:

Asur leorchim littol kelum mimma shellifnehem velitten beyad beno o bitto shel baal habbayit shemma yitbayyesh baal hasseudda shehare en lo ella ma shehevi lifnehem venimtzeu hakketannim notlim otam veholchim. lo yishlach adam lachavero chavit yayin veshemen tzaf al piha shemma yishlach lo adam chavit shekkullah yayin vidamme shehu shemen veshemen hu sheal paneha bilvad vizammen orchim veyitbayyesh. vechen kol kayyotze bidvarim ellu hammeviim lide busha levaal hasseudda asurin:

Gamru milleechol mesallekin et hashshulchan umechabbedin et hammakom sheachlu bo veachar kach notlin et yedehem. shemma yeshayyeru sham perurin sheyyesh bahen kezayit sheasur lehallech bahen velirchotz alehen. aval perurin sheen bahen kezayit muttar leabbedan bayyad:

Heviu lahem mayim lintila kol shemmevarech birkat hammazon hu notel yadav techilla. kede shello yeshev haggadol veyadav mezohamot ad sheyyittol acher. ushear hassoadin notlin yadan bassof ze achar ze. veen mechabbedin bedavar ze sheen mechabbedin beyadayim mezohamot velo bigsharim velo bidrachim ella befetach harauy limzuza uvishat kenisa:
Gamru littol yedehen veniggevu yedehen uverchu birkat hammazon veheviu et hammugmar. mi shebberech birkat hammazon hu mevarech al hammugmar vechullan onin amen:

Im haya sham yayin meviin kos machazik reviit o yater al reviit. umeviin besamim veochez et hayyayin bimino veet habbesamim bismolo umevarech birkat hammazon. veachar kach mevarech al hayyayin. veachar kach mevarech al habbesamim. im hayu habbesamim shemen arev vechayyotze bo tacho berosh hashshammash. veim haya hashshammash talmid chacham tacho bakkotel kede shello yetze mevussam lashshuk:

Af al pi sheen birkat hammazon tzericha yayin. im berech al hayyayin kamminhag sheamarnu tzarich sheyyadiach kos shel beracha mibbifnim velishtof oto mibbachutz. vimalleennu yayin chay. vechevan shehiggia levirkat haaretz noten letocho meat mayim kede sheyyehe arev lishtiyya. veen mesichin al kos shel birkat hammazon ella hakkol shotkim ad shettichle birkat hammazon uvirkat hayyayin veyishtu:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 8: Kol perot hailan mevarchin alehen battechilla bore peri haetz ulevassof bore nefashot rabbot chutz mechameshet hamminin hakketuvin battora. vehem anavim verimmonim uteenim vezetim utemarim shehu mevarech alehen bassof beracha achat meen shalosh. veal perot haaretz vehayerakot mevarchin alehen battechilla bore peri haadama ulevassof bore nefashot rabbot. devarim sheen giddulan min haaretz kegon basar ugevina vedagim uvetzim umayim vechalav udevash vechayyotze bahen battechilla mevarech shehakkol ulevassof bore nefashot rabbot. vehashshote mayim shello lerauot tzamo eno taun beracha lo lefanav velo leacharav:

Hassochet perot vehotzi mehen mashkin mevarech alehen battechilla shehakkol ulevassof bore nefashot. chutz min haanavim vehazzetim. sheal hayyayin hu mevarech bore peri haggafen ulevassof beracha achat meen shalosh. veal hashshemen battechilla hu mevarech bore peri haetz. bamme devarim amurim shehaya choshesh bigrono veshata min hashshemen im me hashshelakot vechayyotze bahen shehare nehene bishtiyyato. aval im shata hashshemen levaddo o shello haya choshesh bigrono mevarech alav shehakkol. shehare lo nehena betaam hashshemen:

Perot o yerakot sheddarkan leheachel chayyim im bishlan o shelakan mevarech alehen battechilla shehakkol ulevassof bore nefashot. virakot sheddarkan leheachel shelukin kegon keruv velefet im achalan chayyin mevarech alehen battechilla shehakkol ulevassof bore nefashot rabbot. veim bishlan o shelakan mevarech alehen bore peri haadama ulevassof bore nefashot rabbot. devarim sheddarkan leheachel chayyin umevushshalin achalan ben chayyin ben mevushshalin mevarech alehen battechilla beracha haruya lahen. im hayu perot etz mevarech bore peri haetz veim hayu perot haadama o yerakot mevarech bore peri haadama:

Yerakot sheddarkan lehishshalek shelakan mevarech al me shelek shellahen bore peri haadama. vehu sheshshelakan lishtot memehen shemmeme hashshelakot kishlakot bemakom sheddarkan lishtotan. devash temarim mevarchin alav techilla shehakkol. aval temarim shemmeachan bayyad vehotzi garinin shellahen vaasaan kemo issa mevarech alehen techilla bore peri haetz ulevassof beracha achat meen shalosh:

Hakkanim hammetukim shessochatin otan umevashshelin memehen ad sheyyikpa veyidme lemelach. kol haggeonim omrim shemmevarchin alav bore peri haadama. umiktzatam amru bore peri haetz. vechen amru shehammotzetz otam kanim mevarech bore peri haadama. vaani omer sheen ze peri veen mevarchin alav ella shehakkol. shello yihye devash ellu hakkanim shennishtanna al yede ur gadol middevash temarim shello nishtanna al yede haur umevarchin alav shehakkol:

Hakkor vehu rosh haddekel shehu kemo etz lavan mevarech alav battechilla shehakkol. kafras shel tzalaf mevarech alav bore peri haadama mippene sheeno peri. vehaevyonot shel tzalaf hen happeri shehen ketzurot temarim dakkim ketannim mevarech alehen bore peri haetz:

Happilpelin vehazzangevil bizman shehen retubbin mevarech alehen bore peri haadama. aval yeveshin en teunin beracha lo lifnehem velo leacharehem mippene shehen tavlin veeno ochel. vechen ochalin sheen reuyin laachila umashkin sheenan reuyin lishtiyya enan teunin beracha lo lifnehen velo leacharehen:

Happat sheippesha vehayyayin shehikrim vetavshil sheavra tzurato vehannovlot shehen paggin vehashshechar vehachometz vehaggovay vehammelach vehakkemehin vehappitriyyot al kullan mevarech techilla shehakkol. vechol hamevarchin lefanav shehakkol laacharona mevarech bore nefashot. vechol hattaun beracha leacharav taun beracha lefanav:

Shemarim shennatan alehem shelosha vehotzi mehen arbaa mevarech alehen bore peri haggafen shezze yayin mazug hu. hotzi pachot mearbaa af al pi sheyyesh bahem taam yayin mevarech alehen shehakkol techilla:
Berech al perot hailan bore peri haadama yatza. veal perot haadama bore peri haetz lo yatza. veal kullam im berech shehakkol yatza. vaafillu al happat veal hayyayin:

Lakach kos shel shechar beyado vehitchil habberacha al menat lomar shehakkol vetaa veamar bore peri haggafen en machzirin oto. vechen im hayu lefanav perot haaretz vehitchil habberacha al menat lomar bore peri haadama vetaa veamar bore peri haetz en machzirin oto. vechen im haya lefanav tavshil shel dagan ufatach al menat lomar bore mine mezonot vetaa veamar hammotzi yatza. mippene shebbeshaa shehizkir et hashshem vehammalchut shehen ikkar habberacha lo nitkavven ella livracha haruya leoto hammin. vehoil velo haya beikkar habberacha taut af al pi shettaa besofah yatza veen machzirin oto:

Kol habberachot haellu im nistappek lo bahem im berech o lo berech eno chozer umevarech lo battechilla velo bassof. mippene shehen middivre sofrim. shachach vehichnis ochalin letoch piv belo beracha. im hayu mashkin bolan umevarech alehen bassof. veim hayu perot sheim zerakan yimmaasu kegon tutim vaanavim mesallekan letzad echad umevarech veachar kach bolan. veim enan nimasin kegon polim vaafunim poltan mippiv ad sheyyevarech ufiv panuy veachar kach ochel:

Hayu lefanav minin harebe im hayu birchotehen shavot mevarech al achat mehem ufoter et hashshear. veim en birchotehem shavot mevarech al kol achat mehen beracha haruya lo. vee ze mehem sheyyirtze lehakedim makdim. veim eno rotze beze yoter mizze im yesh benehem echad mishshivat hamminim alav hu mevarech techilla. vechol hakkodem bappasuk kodem babberacha. vehashshiva hen haamurim befasuk ze <small>(Devarim 8 8)</small> "eretz chitta useora vegefen uteena verimmon eretz zet shemen udevash". udevash ze hu devash temarim. vehattemarim kodmin laanavim. shehattemarim sheni leeretz vehaanavim shelishi leeretz:

Beracha achat shehi meen shalosh shel chameshet hamminin shel perot veshel yayin hi shel mine haddagan. ella sheal happerot hu omer al haetz veal peri haetz veal tenuvat hassade veal eretz chemda vechulei. veal hayyayin hu omer al haggefen veal peri haggefen. vechotem bishtehen al haaretz veal happerot. veim haya beeretz yisrael chotem al haaretz veal peroteha. veyesh mi shemmosif babberacha shemmeen shalosh kodem chatima ki el tov umetiv atta shehu meen beracha reviit. veyesh mi sheamar shello tikkenu beracha reviit ella bevirkat hammazon bilvad:

Shata yayin veachal temarim veachal tavshil shel chameshet mine dagan mevarech baacharona. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam al hammichya veal hakkalkala veal haggefen veal peri haggefen veal haetz veal peri haetz veal tenuvat hassade veal eretz chemda vechulei vechotem baruch atta Adonai al haaretz veal hammichya veal happerot:

Aval im achal basar veshata yayin mevarech bassof al ze bifne atzmo veal ze bifne atzmo. achal teenim o anavim vetappuchim vaagassim vechayyotze bahen mevarech bassof beracha achat meen shalosh vehi kolelet hakkol mippene shekkullan perot haetz. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 9: Keshem sheasur laadam lehanot bemaachol o bemashke kodem beracha. kach asur lo lehanot bereach tov kodem beracha. vechetzad mevarech al reach tov. im haya ze sheyyesh lehariach etz o min haetz mevarech bore atze besamim. veim haya esev o min haesev mevarech bore isve besamim. veim lo haya min haetz velo min haadama kegon hammor shehu min hachayya mevarech bore mine besamim. veim haya peri harauy laachila kegon etrog o tappuach mevarech shennatan reach tov bapperot. veal hakkol im amar bore mine besamim yatza:

En mevarchin al hammugmar ad shettaale timrato. vechetzad mevarchin alav. im haya ze hannisraf shennatan reach meetz mevarchin bore atze besamim. veim haya esev isve besamim. veim haya mimmin chayya vechayyotze bah mevarech alav bore mine besamim:

Shemen shel afarsemon vechayyotze bo mevarech alav bore shemen arev. aval shemen zayit shekkevasho o shettechano ad shechazar recho nodef mevarech alav bore atze besamim. shemen shebbishmo keen shemen hammishcha mevarech alav bore mine besamim. heviu lefanav shemen vahadas mevarech al hahadas ufoter et hashshemen mippene shebberacha achat lishtehen vehu atze besamim:

Hayu lefanav boshom shehu etz uvoshom shehu esev en beracha achat mehen poteret et chavero. ella mevarech al ze leatzmo veal ze leatzmo. heviu lefanav yayin veshemen ochez yayin bimino veshemen bismolo umevarech al hayyayin veshotehu vechozer umevarech al hashshemen umeriach bo vetacho berosh hashshammash. veim haya hashshammash talmid chacham tacho bakkotel:
