Davar shehu safek im min haetz im min haadama mevarech alav bore mine besamim. boshom sheervo harochel mimminin harebe mevarech alav bore mine besamim. nichnas lachanuto shel bosem sheyyesh bah minin harebe mevarech alav bore mine besamim. im yashav sham kol hayyom kullo eno mevarech ella achat. nichnas veyatza nichnas veyatza mevarech al kol paam ufaam:

Hashshoshanna vachalafe hammayim mevarchin alehen bore atze besamim. nargis shel ginna bore atze besamim veshel sade bore isve besamim. havvered ume havvered vehallevona vehammastechi vechayyotze bahen bore atze besamim:
Shelosha mine reach tov en mevarchin alehen veellu hen. reach tov sheasur lehariach bo. vereach tov sheasuy lehaavir reach ra. vereach tov shello naasa lehariach beatzmo shel reach ze:

Ketzad. besamim shel akkum uvesamim shel erva min haarayot en mevarchin alehen lefi sheasur lehariach bahen. besamim shel metim uvesamim shel bet hakkisse veshemen heasuy lehaavir et hazzuhama en mevarchin alehen lefi shennaasu lehaavir reach ra. mugmar shemmegammerin bo et hakkelim veet habbegadim en mevarchin alehen lefi shello naasa lehariach beatzmo shel mugmar. vechen hammeriach bivgadim shehen megummarim eno mevarech lefi sheen sham ikkar boshom ella reach belo ikkar:

Besamim shel mesibba shel akkum en mevarchin alehem shessetam mesibbat akkum laavodat kochavim. haya mehallech chutz lakkerach veheriach reach tov. im rov hair akkum eno mevarech. veim rov yisrael mevarech. nitarev reach shemmevarchin alav berech sheen mevarchin alav holchin achare harov:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 10: Verachot acherot udevaroym acherim harebe sheen bahen peticha velo chatima tikkenu chachamim derech shevach vehodaya lehakkadosh baruch hu. kemo birchot hattefilla shekkevar ketavnum. veellu hen. habbone bayit chadash vehakkone kelim chodashim ben yesh lo kayyotze bahen ben en lo mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam shehecheyanu vekiyyemanu vehiggianu lazzeman hazze:

Vechen haroe et chavero leachar sheloshim yom mevarech shehecheyanu. veim raahu leachar shenem asar chodesh mevarech baruch atta Adonai mechayye hammetim. haroe peri hammitchaddesh mishshana leshana bitchillat reiyyato mevarech shehecheyanu:

Shama shemua tova mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hattov vehammetiv. shama shemua raa mevarech baruch dayyan haemet. vechayyav adam levarech al haraa betuv nefesh kederech shemmevarech al hattova besimcha shenneemar <small>(Devarim 6 5)</small> "veahavta et Adonai elohecha" vegomer <small>(Devarim 6 5)</small> "uvechol meodecha". uvichlal ahava hayetera shennitztavvenu bah sheafillu beet sheyyatzer lo yode vishabbeach besimcha:

Higgia elav tova o sheshshama shemua tova af al pi shehaddevarim marin shettova zo tigrom lo raa mevarech hattov vehammetiv. vechen im naga elav raa o shama shemua raa af al pi shehaddevarim marim sheraa zo goremet lo tova mevarech dayyan haemet. sheen mevarchin al heatid lihyot ella al ma sheera atta:

Yardu geshamim rabbim. im yesh lo sade mevarech shehecheyanu. veim hayta shello veshel acherim mevarech hattov vehammetiv. veim en lo sade mevarech modim anachnu lach Adonai elohenu al kol tippa vetippa shehoradta lanu veillu finu male kulei ad hen hem yodu vishabbechu vivarchu et shimcha malkenu baruch atta Adonai el rov hahodaot vehattishbachot:
Meematay mevarchin al haggeshamim mishsheyyirbe hammayim al haaretz veyaalu avabuot min hammatar al pene hammayim veyelchu haavabuot ze likrat ze:

Amru lo met aviv virashahu. im yesh immo achin mevarech battechilla dayyan haemet veachar kach hattov vehammetiv. veim en immo achim mevarech shehecheyanu. ketzaro shel davar kol devar tova shehi lo velaacherim mevarech hattov vehammetiv. vetova shehi lo levaddo mevarech shehecheyanu:

Arbaa tzerichin lehodot. chole shennitrappe. vechavush sheyyatza mibbet haasurim. veyorde hayyam keshealu. veholche derachim kesheyyaggiu layyishshuv. utzerichin lehodot bifne asara ushenayim mehem chachamim shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 107 32)</small> "virommuhu bikhal am uvemoshav zekenim yehalluhu". vechetzad mode vechetzad mevarech. omed benehen umevarech. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam haggomel lechayyavim tovot sheggemalani kol tov. vechol hashshomin omrim sheggemalcha tov hu yigmalcha sela:

Haroe makom shennaasu nissim leyisrael kegon yam suf umaberot hayyarden omer baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam sheasa nissim laavotenu bammakom hazze. vechen kol makom shennaasu bo nissim larabbim. aval makom shennaasa bo nes layyachid oto hayyachid uveno uven beno mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam sheasa li nes bammakom hazze o sheasa nes laavotay bammakom hazze. haroe gov arayot vechivshan haesh shehushlach bo chananya mishael vaazarya mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam sheasa nes latztzaddikim bammakom hazze. haroe makom sheovdin bo akkum mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam shennatan erech appayim leovre retzono. makom shenneekra mimmennu akkum im beeretz yisrael hu mevarech sheakar akkum meartzenu. veim bechutz laaretz hu mevarech sheakar akkum mimmakom hazze. veomer bishtehen keshem sheakarta mimmakom ze kach taakor mikkol mekomot vetashiv lev ovdehem leavdecha:

Haroe batte yisrael beyishshuvan mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam matztziv gevul almana. bechurbanan omer baruch dayyan haemet. haroe kivre yisrael mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher yatzar etchem baddin vedan etchem baddin vechilkel etchem bedin vehemit etchem baddin vehu atid lehakim etchem baddin lechayye haolam habba baruch atta Adonai mechayye hammetim:

Haroe shesh meot elef adam keechad. im akkum hem omer <small>(yirmeya 50 12)</small> "bosha immechem meod chafra yoladtechem hinne acharit goyim midbar tziyya vaarava". veim yisrael hem uveeretz yisrael omer baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam chacham harazim. haroe mechachme ummot haolam omer baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam shennatan mechachmato levasar vadam. chachme yisrael mevarech shennatan mechachmato lireav. malche yisrael omer shennatan mikkevodo umiggevurato lireav. malche ummot haolam mevarech shennatan mikkevodo levasar vadam:

Haroe et hakkushi veet hameshunnin betzurat penehen o beevrehem mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam meshanne et habberiyyot. haroe suma o kittea umukke shechin uvohakanin vechayyotze bahen mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam dayyan haemet. veim noldu ken mimmee imman mevarech meshanne et habberiyyot. haroe et happil veet hakkof veet hakkifof omer baruch meshanne et habberiyyot:

Haroe beriyyot naot umetukkanot beyoter veilanot tovot mevarech shekkacha lo beolamo. hayyotze lassadot o lagginnot beyome nisan veraa ilanot porchot venitztzanim olim mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam shello chissar beolamo kelum uvara bo beriyyot tovot veilanot tovot venaot kede lehanot bahen bene adam:

Al haruchot shennashvu bezaaf veal habberakim veal haramim veal kol hahavara shettishshama baaretz kemo rechayim gedolim veal haur shebbaavir sheyyerau keillu hem kochavim noflim veratzim mimmakom lemakom o kemo kochavim sheyyesh lahem zanav al kol echad meellu mevarech baruch shekkocho ugevurato male olam. veim ratza mevarech ose bereshit:

Al heharim veal haggevaot al hayyammim veal hammidbarot veal hanneharot im raa achat mehen mishsheloshim yom lishloshim yom mevarech ose bereshit. haroe et hayyam haggadol mishsheloshim yom lishloshim yom o yoter mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam sheasa et hayyam haggadol:

Haroe keshet beanan mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam zocher habberit veneeman bivrito vekayyam bemaamaro. haroe levana bechiddushah mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher bemaamaro bara shechakim uveruach piv kol tzevaam chok uzeman natan lahem shello yeshannu et tafkidam sasim usemechim laasot retzon konehem poale emet ufeullatam tzedek velallevana amar shettitchaddesh atara tiferet laamuse vaten shehem atidin lehitchaddesh kemotah ulefaer leyotzram al kevod malchuto veal kol ma shebbara baruch atta Adonai mechaddesh hechodashim:

Vetzarich levarech beracha zo meummad. shekkol hamevarech al hachodesh bizmanno keillu hikbil pene hashshechina. im lo berech aleha ballayil harishon mevarech aleha ad shishsha asar yom bachodesh ad shettimmale pegimatah:

Haroe et hachamma beyom tekufat nisan shel techillat hammachazor shel shemone veesrim shana shehattekufa bitchillat lel revii kesheroe otah beyom revii babboker mevarech baruch ose bereshit. vechen keshettachazor hallevana litchillat mazzal tale bitchillat hachodesh velo tihye nota lo letzafon velo ledarom. vechen kesheyyachazor kol kochav vechochav mechameshet hakkochavim hannisharim litchillat mazzal tale velo yihye note lo letzafon velo ledarom. vechen bechol et sheyyire mazzal tale ole mikketze hammizrach al kol echad meellu mevarech ose bereshit:

Haroe batte akkum beyishshuvan omer <small>(Mishlei 15 25)</small> "bet geim yissach Adonai". bechurbanan omer <small>(Tehillim 94 1)</small> "el nekamot Adonai el nekamot hofia". raa kivre akkum omer <small>(yirmeya 50 12)</small> "bosha immechem meod" vegomer:

Hannichnas lammerchatz omer yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay shettachniseni leshalom vetotzieni leshalom vetatztzileni mizze umikkayyotze baze leatid lavo. uchesheyyetze min hammerchatz omer mode ani lefanecha Adonai elohay shehitztzaltani min haur vechulei:
Hannichnas lehakkiz dam omer yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay sheyyehe esek ze li lirfua ki rofe chinnam atta. uchesheyyetze omer baruch atta Adonai rofe cholim:

Haholech lamod garno omer yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay shettishlach beracha bemaase yaday. hitchil lamod omer baruch hashsholeach beracha bichri ze. madad veachar kach bikkesh rachamim hare zo tefillat shav. vechol hatztzoek lesheavar hare zo tefillat shav:

Hannichnas levet hammidrash omer yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay shello ekkashel bidvar halacha shello omar al tahor tame veal tame tahor velo al muttar asur velo al asur muttar velo ekkashel bidvar halacha veyismechu bi chaveray veal yikkashlu chaveray veesmach bahem:

Uvitziato mibbet hammidrash omer mode ani lefanecha Adonai elohay shessamta chelki miyyoshve bet hammidrash velo samta chelki miyyoshve keranot sheani mashkim vehem mashkimim ani mashkim ledivre tora vehem mashkimim lidvarim betelim ani amel vehem amelin ani amel ledivre tora umekabbel sachar vehem amelin veen mekabbelin sachar ani ratz vehem ratzim ani ratz lechayye haolam habba vehem ratzim liver shachat:

Hannichnas lichrach omer yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay shettachniseni lichrach ze leshalom. veim nichnas beshalom omer mode ani lefanecha Adonai elohay shehichnastani leshalom. uchesheyyevakkesh latzet omer yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay shettotzieni mikkerach ze leshalom. veim yatza beshalom omer mode ani lefanecha Adonai elohay shehotzetani mikkerach ze leshalom ucheshem shehotzetani leshalom kach tolicheni leshalom vetatzideni leshalom vetismecheni leshalom vetatztzileni mikkaf oyev veorev badderech:

Kelalo shel davar leolam yitzak adam al heatid lavo vivakkesh rachamim veyitten hodaya al ma sheavar veyode vishabbeach kefi kocho. vechol hammarbe lehodot et Adonai uleshabbecho tamid hare ze meshubbach:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 11: Kol habberachot kullan poteach bahem bevaruch vechotem bahem bevaruch chutz mibberacha acharona shel keriat shema uveracha hassemucha lachavertah uvirkat happerot vehaddome lah uvirkat asiyyat hammitzvot. umeellu habberachot sheamarnu shehen derech shevach vehodaya yesh mehen poteach bevaruch veeno chotem bevaruch. veyesh mehen shehu chotem bevaruch veeno poteach bevaruch, ella meat mibbirkat hammitzvot kegon birkat sefer tora veroe kivre yisrael meellu shehen derech shevach vehodaya. aval shear birchot hammitzvot kullan poteach bahen bevaruch veeno chotem:

Yesh mitzvot ase sheadam chayyav lehishtaddel velirdof ad sheyyaase otah kegon tefillin vesukka velulav veshofar veellu hen hannikrain chova. lefi sheadam chayyav al kol panim laasot. veyesh mitzva sheenah chova ella domin lirshut kegon mezuza umaake sheen adam chayyav lishkon bevayit hachayyav mezuza kede sheyyaase mezuza ella im ratza lishkon kol yamav beohel o bisfina yeshev. vechen eno chayyav livnot bayit kede laasot maake. vechol mitzvot ase shebben adam lammakom ben mitzva sheenah chova ben mitzva shehi chova mevarech aleha kodem laasiyyatah:

Vechen kol hammitzvot shehen middivre sofrim ben mitzva shehi chova middivrehem kegon mikra megilla vehadelakat ner beshabbat vehadelakat ner chanukka. ben mitzvot sheenan chova kegon eruv unetilat yadayim. mevarech al hakkol kodem laasiyyatan asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu laasot. vehechan tzivvanu battora. shekkatuv bah <small>(Devarim 17 11)</small> "asher yomru lecha taase". nimtza inyan haddevarim vehetztzean kach hu. asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav shetztzivva bahen lishmoa meellu shetztzivvanu lehadelik ner shel chanukka o likrot et hammegilla. vechen shear kol hammitzvot shemmiddivre sofrim:

Velamma en mevarchin al netilat yadayim baacharona. mippene shello chiyyevu bedavar ze ella mippene hassakkana udevarim shehem mishshum sakkana en mevarchin alehem. ha lema ze dome lemi shessinnen et hammayim veachar kach shata ballayla mippene sakkanat aluka sheeno mevarech vetzivvanu lesannen et hammayim. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hose mitzva velo berech. im mitzva sheadayin asiyyatah kayyemet mevarech achar asiyya veim davar sheavar hu eno mevarech. ketzad. hare shennitattef betzitzit o shellavash tefillin o sheyyashav besukka velo berech techilla chozer umevarech achar shennitattef asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehitattef betzitzit. vechen mevarech achar shellavash lehaniach tefillin. veachar sheyyashav leshev bassukka. vechen kol kayyotze baellu:

Aval im shachat belo beracha eno chozer achar shechita umevarech asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al hashshechita. vechen im kissa haddam belo beracha o hifrish teruma umaasrot o shettaval velo berech eno chozer umevarech achar asiyya. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

En lecha mitzva shemmevarchin achar asiyyatah ella tevilat hagger bilvad sheeno yachol lomar asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu sheadayin lo nitkaddesh velo nitztavva ad sheyyitbol. lefichach achar sheyyitbol mevarech al hattevila mippene shehaya dachuy meikkaro velo haya rauy levarech:

Kol mitzva sheasiyyatah hi gemar chiyyuvah mevarech bishat asiyya. vechol mitzva sheyyesh achar asiyyatah tziuuy acher eno mevarech ella beshaa sheose hatztziuuy haacharon. ketzad. haose sukka o lulav o shofar o tzitzit o tefillin o mezuza eno mevarech bishat asiyya asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu laasot sukka o lulav o lichtov tefillin mippene sheyyesh achar asiyyato tziuuy acher. veematay mevarech beshaa sheyyeshev bassukka o kesheyyenaanea hallulav o kesheyyishma kol hashshofar o kesheyyitattef batztzitzit uvishat levishat tefillin uvishat keviat mezuza. aval im asa maake mevarech bishat asiyya asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu laasot maake. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Kol mitzva shehi mizzeman lizman kegon shofar vesukka velulav umikra megilla vener chanukka. vechen kol mitzva umitzva shehi kinyan lo kegon tzitzit utefillin umezuza umaake. vechen mitzva sheenah tedira veenah metzuya bechol et shehare hi doma lemitzva shehi mizzeman lizman kegon milat beno ufidyon habben, mevarech aleha bishat asiyyatah shehecheyanu. veim lo berech al sukka velulav vechayyotze bahem shehecheyanu bishat asiyya mevarech alehen shehecheyanu beshaa sheyyetze yede chovato bahen. vechen kol kayyotze bahen:

Echad haose mitzva leatzmo veechad haose otah laacherim mevarech kodem asiyyatah asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu laasot. aval eno mevarech shehecheyanu ella al mitzva sheose otah leatzmo. hayu lefanav mitzvot harebe eno mevarech asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al hammitzvot ella mevarech al kol achat veachat bifne atzmah:
Kol haose mitzva ben shehayta chova alav ben sheenah chova alav im asa otah leatzmo mevarech laasot. asa otah laacherim mevarech al haasiyya:

Ketzad. lavash tefillin mevarech lehaniach tefillin. nitattef betzitzit mevarech lehitattef. yashav besukka mevarech leshev bassukka. vechen hu mevarech lehadelik ner shel shabbat veligmor et hahallel. vechen im kava mezuza leveto mevarech likboa mezuza. asa maake legaggo mevarech asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu laasot maake. hifrish teruma leatzmo mevarech lehaferish. mal et beno mevarech lamul et habben. shachat pischo vachagigato mevarech lishchot:

Aval im kava mezuza laacherim mevarech al keviat mezuza. asa lahem maake mevarech al asiyyat maake. hifrish lahem teruma mevarech al haferashat teruma. mal et ben chavero mevarech al hammila. vechen kol kayyotze beellu:

Asa hammitzva lo velaacherim keechad im hayta mitzva sheenah chova mevarech al haasiyya. lefichach hu mevarech al mitzvat eruv. hayta chova venitkavven lehotzi atzmo mide chova ulehotzi acherim mevarech laasot. lefichach hu mevarech lishmoa kol shofar:

Natal et hallulav mevarech al netilat lulav shekkevan shehigbiho yatza yede chovato. aval im berech kodem sheyyittol mevarech littol lulav kemo leshev bassukka. mikkan atta lamed shehamevarech achar sheasa mevarech al haasiyya. aval netilat yadayim ushechita hoil uvedivre harshut hen afillu shachat leatzmo mevarech al hashshechita veal kissuy haddam veal netilat yadayim. vechach hu mevarech al biur chametz ben shebbadak leatzmo ben shebbadak laacherim shemmishshaa sheggamar belibbo levattel naaset mitzvat habbiur kodem sheyyivdok kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo:

Kol davar shehu minhag af al pi shemminhag neviim hu kegon netilat arava bishvii shel chag veen tzarich lomar minhag chachamim kegon keriat hallel berashe chodashim uvechullo shel moed shel pesach en mevarchin alav. vechen kol davar sheyyistappek lecha im taun beracha im lav osin oto belo beracha. uleolam yizzaher adam bivracha sheenah tzericha veyarbe babberachot hatztzerichot. vechen david amar (Tehillim 145 2) "bechol yom avarchekka":
selik hilchot berachot
Mishneh Torah, Borrowing and Deposit 1: Hashshoel kelim o behema vechayyotze bahen mishshear mittaltelin mechavero veavad o nignav afillu neenas ones gadol kegon shennishbera habbehema o nishbet o meta chayyav leshallem hakkol shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 13)</small> "vechi yishal ish meim reehu" vegomer <small>(Shemot 22 13)</small> "venishbar o met bealav en immo shallem yeshallem". bamme devarim amurim keshenneenas shello bishat melacha. aval im shaal behema mechavero lachrosh bah umeta keshehi choreshet hare ze patur. aval im meta kodem sheyyacharosh bah o achar shecharash bah o sherachav aleha o dash bah umeta keshehi dasha o bishat rechiva hare ze chayyav leshallem. vechen kol kayyotze baze. vechen hashshoel behema mechavero lelech bah lemakom peloni umeta tachtav beotah hadderech. o sheshshaal deli lemalleot bo venikra babbor bishat milluy. o sheshshaal kardom lefatztzel bo etzim venishbar beet sheppitztzel bo mechamat habbikkua. vechol kayyotze baze. hare ze patur shello shaal ella laasot bo melacha zo vahare lo shinna:

Hashshoel behema mechavero umeta vetaan hashshoel shebbishat melacha meta. im haya hammakom sheshshaala lelech bo makom shebbene adam metzuyin sham yavi reaya shemmeta o neensa bishat melacha veshello shinna bah veyippater. veim lo hevi reaya meshallem. sheala mimmennu lemalleot bah afar shebbechurbato sheen haedim metzuyin sham. o sheshshaal mimmennu deli lemalleot bo habbor betoch beto venikra babbor. im hevi reaya yippater af mishshevua veim lav yishshava hashshoel shevuat hashshomrim shemmeta bishat melacha veyippater. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hashshoel keli mechavero venishbar shamin lo kederech sheshshamin binzakin. omdin kamma haya shave shalem vechamma hu shave atta umachazir lo hakkeli o habbehema hashshevura umeshallem happechat. vechen im meta habbehema machzir hannevela umeshallem happechat:

Hashshoel behema chayyav bimzonoteha mishshaa shemmeshachah ad sof yeme sheelatah. veim kachash besarah chayyav leshallem ma sheppachata bedameha. kachash besarah mechamat hammelacha patur veyishshava shevuat hashshomrin shemmechamat melacha kachasha:

Hashshoel keli mechavero o behema setam hare hammashil machziro bechol et sheyyirtze. shealo lizman katzuv kevan shemmashach vezacha en habbealim yecholin lehacheziro mittachat yado ad sof yeme hashsheela. vaafillu met hashshoel hare hayyorshin mishtammeshin bashsheela ad sof hazzeman. vedin hu. hallokeach kone hagguf kinyan olam baddamim shennatan umekabbel mattana kana hagguf kinyan olam velo natan kelum vehassocher kana hagguf leferotav ad zeman katzuv baddamim shennatan vehashshoel kana hagguf leferotav ad zeman katzuv velo natan kelum. keshem shehannoten kammocher sheeno yachol lachzor bo leolam kach hammashil kammaskir sheeno yachol lachzor betoch hazzeman. hinniach lahem avihem para sheula umeta en chayyavin boonaseha. chashvu shehi shel avihem tevachuha vaachaluha meshallemin deme basar bezol. veim hinniach lahem avihem nechasim umeta o shettevachuha meshallemin et dameha minnechasav:

Hashshoel keli mechavero laasot bo melacha pelonit en hammashil yachol lehacheziro mittachat yado ad sheyyaase bo otah melacha. vechen im shaal mimmennu behema lelech bah bemakom peloni eno yachol lehachezirah miyyad hashshoel ad sheyyelech bah lesham veyachzor:

Haomer lachavero hasheileni kardom laador bo happardes hazze oder bo oto happardes bilvad veeno rashshay laador bo pardes acher. amar lo pardes setam oder bo pardes acher e ze sheyyirtze. shealo laador bo pardesim (harebe shello) oder bo kol happardesim shello. vaafillu nishchat kol habbarzel baadira machzir lo hannitztzav shel etz. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hashshoel keli mechavero lehishtammesh bo veamar lo hasheileni davar peloni betovatcha kelomar en atta mashil li davar ze kederech kol hammashilin ella kefi tovat libbecha venidvotecha sheencha makpid al hazzeman im arach. im kanu miyyad hammashil al ze hare hashshoel mishtammesh bo leolam ad sheyyitbattel hakkeli millaasot melachto veyachzir shevarav o sheyarav. veen hashshoel rashshay lachzor uletakken hakkeli o laasoto paam acheret:

Haomer lachavero hasheileni shoket zo shel mayim venehersa [eno yachol livnotah. amar lo hasheileni shoket setam venehersa] yesh lo livnotah. amar lo hasheileni mekom shoket im kano miyyad hammashil hare hashshoel bone veholech bekarka hammashil ad shettavo leyado shoket sheefshar lehashekot mimmenna behemto o artzo kemo shehitna im hammashil:

Hashshoel pundak mechavero lelina en pachot miyyom echad. lishvita en pachot mishshene yamim. lenissuim en pachot mishsheloshim yom. shaal chaluk mechavero lelech bo levet haavel kede sheyyelech veyachzor. shealo levet hammishte kol oto hayyom. shealo laasot hammishte shello en pachot mishshiva yamim:
Mishneh Torah, Borrowing and Deposit 2:
Hashoel babbealim afillu nignav o avad bifshia patur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 14)</small> "im bealav immo lo yeshallem". uvilvad sheshshaal habbealim techilla im hachefetz kemo shebbearnu. veechad hashshoel et habbealim o shessecharan veechad sheshshoel et habbealim leotah hammelacha o sheshshealan usecharan limlacha acheret o leshum davar baolam. afillu amar lachavero hashekeni mayim veshaal mimmennu behemto vehishkahu venatan lo et habbehema hare zo sheela bivalim ufatur. mashach et habbehema battechilla veachar kach hishkahu enah sheela bivalim. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hishil behemto o hiskirah lemassoy veyatza immah lesoodah im hashshoel o hassocher veliton immo bemassao hare zo shemira babbealim. veim yatza levakker hammassooy bilvad velirot shello yitanu aleha yeter min harauy enah shemira babbealim: 
Melammed tinokot. vehannotea livne hammedina. vehammakkiz lahem et haddam. vehassofer shellahen. kol echad meellu vechayyotze bahen bayyom shehu yoshev bo laasok bimlachtan im hishil o hiskir leechad meellu shehu osek bimlachtam hare zo shemira babbealim vaafillu pasha bah hashshomer patur. aval hu sheshshaal o shessachar mehen chayyav sheenan sheulin lo: 
Harav shehu makri birtzono lattalmidim bechol et sheyyirtze veezo massechta sheyyirtze vehem hayu kevuim lavo tamid venishmat lahen mimmassechta lemassechta hare hen sheulin etzlo veen hu shaul lahem. uveyom happerek shehakkol bain lishmoa inyan oto moed hare hu shaul lahem vehem enan sheulin lo: 
Haomer lishlucho tze vehishshael im parati enah sheela babbealim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 14)</small> "im bealav immo lo yeshallem" habbealim atzman lo shaliach. amar leavdo hakkenaani tze vehishshael im parati hare zo sheela babbealim sheyyad haeved keyad rabbo. nishal haeved immah shello middaat rabbo enah sheela babbealim: 
Hashshoel min haishsha venishal lo balah enah sheela babbealim shekkinyan perot eno kekinyan hagguf veen labbaal ella perot: 
Hashshoel meishto o shuttafin sheshshaalu ze mizze hare zo sheela babbealim. veim amar hashuttaf lachavero hasheileni hayyom veashilcha lemachar enah sheela babbealim: 
Shaal min hashshuttafin venishal lo echad mehen vechen hashshuttafin sheshshaalu venishal leechad mehen hare ze safek im hi sheela babbealim im enah. lefichach im meta eno meshallem. veim tafsu habbealim en motziin miyyadam. pasha bah hare ze meshallem: 
Hashshoel et habbehema babbealim leravah o lehareot bah o laasot bah pachot mishsheve peruta o sheshshaal shete parot laasot bahen sheve peruta hare kol ellu sefek sheela babbealim: 
Shealah babbealim usecharah shello babbealim patur shehassechirut taluy bashsheela. aval im secharah babbealim vechazar ushealah shello babbealim o sheshsheala babbealim vechazar usecharah shello babbealim vechazar ushealah (shello) babbealim o shessecharah babbealim vechazar ushealah shello babbealim vechazar usecharah (shello) babbealim kol ellu sefek shemira babbealim hu: 
Ishsha sheshshaala veachar kach nisset hare habbaal kelokeach mimmenna veeno lo shomer sachar velo shoel. lefichach im hayta devar hashsheela behema umeta habbaal patur af al pi shehu mishtammesh bah kol yeme sheelatah afillu pasha mippene shehu kelokeach vehaishsha chayyevet leshallem kesheyyihye lah mamon. veim hodia et balah shehi sheula hare ze nichnas tachteha. kol sheamarnu shehi sheela babbealim kach im haya socher o nose sachar hare hi sechirut babbealim ufatur. vechol sheenah sheela babbealim kach enah sechirut babbealim. vechol shehu safek bishela kach hu safek bischirut:
